kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Johana aabatithanagia na maaĩ, no inyuĩ mũrĩbatithio na Roho Mũtheru mĩthenya mĩingĩ ĩtaanathira.”
english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

kikuyu: kwambĩrĩria hĩndĩ ya ũbatithio wa Johana nginya hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Jesũ oirwo akĩambata akĩehera harĩ ithuĩ. Nĩgũkorwo mũndũ ũmwe wa aya no nginya atuĩke mũira hamwe na ithuĩ ũhoro-inĩ wa kũriũka gwake.”
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ nĩamenyete ũhoro ũcio mbere, nĩaririe ũhoro wa kũriũka gwa Kristũ, atĩ ndaatiganĩirio mbĩrĩra-inĩ, o na kana mwĩrĩ wake ũkĩbutha.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades,† and his flesh didn’t see decay.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ othe a Isiraeli nĩmamenye atĩrĩ: Ngai nĩ atuĩte Jesũ, o ũcio mwambire, Mwathani na Kristũ.”
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa meetĩkĩrire ndũmĩrĩri yake makĩbatithio, na mũthenya ũcio makĩongerereka andũ ta ngiri ithatũ.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũndũ waciarĩtwo arĩ mwonju nĩakuuagwo agatwarwo kĩhingo-inĩ kĩa hekarũ kĩrĩa gĩetagwo Gĩthaka, akaigwo ho o mũthenya nĩguo ahooe mbeeca kũrĩ andũ arĩa maatoonyaga hekarũ.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

kikuyu: Nao Petero na Johana makĩmũkũũrĩra maitho. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Petero akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ta tũrore!”
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

kikuyu: Akĩmũnyiita guoko gwake kwa ũrĩo, akĩmũrũgamia na igũrũ, na o hĩndĩ ĩyo magũrũ na thũngʼwa cia mũndũ ũcio ikĩgĩa na hinya.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

kikuyu: Ngai wa Iburahĩmu, na Isaaka na Jakubu, o we Ngai wa maithe maitũ, nĩagoocithĩtie ndungata yake Jesũ. Inyuĩ nĩmwamũneanire ooragwo, na mũkĩmũkaana mbere ya Pilato, o na gũtuĩka nĩatuĩte itua rĩa kũmũrekereria.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

kikuyu: Nĩmaiguĩte ũũru mũno tondũ atũmwo nĩmarutaga andũ na makahunjia ũhoro wa kũriũka kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ thĩinĩ wa Jesũ.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ mũndũ wacookire kũgeria gwĩturanĩra nao, o na gũtuĩka andũ nĩmamaheete gĩtĩĩo mũno.
english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

kikuyu: O na kũrĩ ũguo-rĩ, arũme na andũ-a-nja aingĩ nĩmetĩkirie Mwathani, naguo mũigana wao ũkĩongerereka.
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

kikuyu: No ũtukũ- rĩ, mũraika wa Mwathani akĩhingũra mĩrango ya njeera, na akĩmoimia nja.
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

kikuyu: Ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, thuurai andũ mũgwanja kuuma gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu, andũ arĩa moĩkaine atĩ nĩ maiyũrĩtwo nĩ Roho, o na ũũgĩ, na nĩtũkũmehokera wĩra ũcio,
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Ngai akiuga atĩrĩ, ‘No nĩngaherithia rũrĩrĩ rũu igaatungata irĩ ngombo; na thuutha ũcio-rĩ, nĩikoima bũrũri ũcio, nacio nĩikaahooya irĩ kũndũ gũkũ.’
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’*

kikuyu: Nĩonire mũndũ ũmwe wao akĩnyariirwo nĩ mũndũ wa Misiri. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩthiĩ kũmũũrĩria na akĩmũrĩhĩria na ũndũ wa kũũraga mũndũ ũcio Mũmisiri.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna yarĩkia gũthira-rĩ, mũraika akiumĩrĩra Musa arĩ nĩnĩmbĩ-inĩ cia mwaki iria ciakanaga kĩhinga-inĩ kũu werũ-inĩ hakuhĩ na Kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

kikuyu: “ ‘Igũrũ nĩkuo gĩtĩ gĩakwa kĩa ũnene, nayo thĩ nĩ gaturwa ka makinya makwa. Ũngĩkĩnjakĩra nyũmba ya mũthemba ũrĩkũ? Ũguo nĩguo Mwathani ekũũria. Kana kĩhurũko gĩakwa kĩngĩkorwo kũ?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ikundi cia andũ ciaiguire Filipu na ikĩona ciama iria aaringaga, othe magĩthikĩrĩria ũrĩa oigaga.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maarĩkirie kũheana ũira na kũhunjia kiugo kĩa Mwathani-rĩ, Petero na Johana magĩcooka Jerusalemu, o makĩhunjagia Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega tũtũũra-inĩ tũingĩ twa Samaria.
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: na arĩ njĩra-inĩ akĩinũka, aaikarĩte ngaari-inĩ yake ya mbarathi agĩthoma ibuku rĩa Isaia ũrĩa mũnabii.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

kikuyu: Nake agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Ingĩtaũkĩrwo atĩa, tiga hagĩire mũndũ wa kũndaarĩria?” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩĩra Filipu ahaice ngaari ĩyo ya mbarathi, aikaranie nake.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

kikuyu: Ihinda rĩa matukũ matatũ aarĩ mũtumumu, na ndarĩ kĩndũ aarĩĩaga kana akanyua.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

kikuyu: Na hĩndĩ ĩyo akĩambĩrĩria kũhunjia thunagogi-inĩ atĩ Jesũ nĩ Mũrũ wa Ngai.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

kikuyu: No arũmĩrĩri aake makĩmuoya ũtukũ, makĩmũharũrũkia arĩ gĩkabũ-inĩ mamũgereirie mwanya warĩ rũthingo-inĩ.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

kikuyu: Nake Petero akĩmeera othe moime nja ya nyũmba; agĩcooka agĩturia maru akĩhooya Ngai. Agĩcooka akĩgarũrũkĩra mũtumia ũcio wakuĩte, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Tabitha, ũkĩra,” nake Tabitha akĩhingũra maitho, na oona Petero, agĩĩtiira.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

kikuyu: Araikara gwa Simoni ũria mũtanduki wa njũũa, o ũrĩa nyũmba yake ĩrĩ rũtere-inĩ rwa iria.”
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.‡

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ũkĩra ũikũrũke, ũthiĩ nao na ndũkagĩe na nganja nĩgũkorwo nĩ niĩ ndĩmatũmĩte.”
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

kikuyu: Nake Petero akĩambĩrĩria kwaria, akiuga atĩrĩ: “Rĩu nĩndamenya kũna ũrĩa arĩ ma atĩ Ngai ndarĩ mũthutũkanio.
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

kikuyu: “Ithuĩ tũrĩ aira a maũndũ marĩa mothe eekire thĩinĩ wa bũrũri wa Ayahudi o na Jerusalemu. Nĩmamũũragire na njĩra ya kũmwamba mũtĩ-igũrũ.
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also‡ killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: “O hĩndĩ ĩyo andũ atatũ arĩa maatũmĩtwo kũrĩ niĩ kuuma Kaisarea magĩkinya nyũmba-inĩ ĩrĩa ndaikaraga.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa aakinyire na akĩona ũira wa wega wa Ngai, agĩkena na akĩmomĩrĩria marĩ othe, atĩ maikarage maathĩkĩire Mwathani na ngoro ciao ciothe.
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

kikuyu: na rĩrĩa aamuonire akĩmũrehe Antiokia. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio kwa ihinda rĩa mwaka ũmwe Baranaba na Saũlũ makĩgomana na kanitha na makĩruta andũ aingĩ. Kũu Antiokia nĩkuo arutwo meetirwo Akristiano riita rĩa mbere.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ihinda-inĩ rĩu nĩguo Mũthamaki Herode aanyiitire andũ amwe a kanitha, arĩ na muoroto wa kũmanyariira.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

kikuyu: Makĩhĩtũka arangĩri a mbere na a keerĩ na magĩkinya kĩhingo-inĩ gĩa kĩgera kĩrĩa gĩa gũtoonya itũũra inene. Nakĩo kĩhingo kĩu gĩkĩĩhingũra nĩ ũndũ wao, nao makĩgerera ho. Rĩrĩa maathiire ũraihu wa gacĩra kamwe-rĩ, o rĩmwe mũraika ũcio akĩmũtiga.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

kikuyu: Rũciinĩ gwakĩa, nĩ kwagĩire na ngũĩ nene gatagatĩ-inĩ ga thigari nĩ kũrigwo nĩ ũrĩa gwekĩkĩte ũhoro ũkoniĩ Petero.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Mwathani atwathĩte agatwĩra atĩrĩ: “ ‘Nĩndĩmũtuĩte ũtheri wa gũtherera andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ, nĩguo mũtware ũhoro wa ũhonokio nginya ituri-inĩ cia thĩ.’ ”
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’ ”*

kikuyu: Nao arutwo makĩiyũrwo ni gĩkeno, na makĩiyũrwo nĩ Roho Mũtheru.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: No arutwo maarĩkia kũmũrigiicĩria, agĩũkĩra agĩcooka itũũra-inĩ. Mũthenya ũcio ũngĩ warũmĩrĩire, we na Baranaba makiuma kũu magĩthiĩ Deribe.
english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

kikuyu: Maakinya kũu magĩcookanĩrĩria andũ a kanitha hamwe, makĩmeera ũrĩa wothe Ngai ekĩte agereire harĩo na ũrĩa aahingũrĩire andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ mũrango wa gwĩtĩkia.
english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mĩario mĩingĩ, Petero akĩrũgama, akĩmarĩria, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, nĩmũũĩ atĩ ihinda rĩhĩtũku, Ngai nĩathuurire kuuma gatagatĩ kanyu nĩguo andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ maigue ndũmĩrĩri ya Ũhoro- ũrĩa-Mwega kuuma kũrĩ niĩ na nĩguo metĩkie.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

kikuyu: Aca! Twĩtĩkĩtie atĩ tũhonokete nĩ ũndũ wa wega wa Mwathani witũ Jesũ, o ta ũrĩa o nao mahonokete.”
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus,‡ just as they are.”

kikuyu: Nakĩo kĩũngano gĩothe gĩgĩkira ki gĩgĩthikĩrĩria Baranaba na Paũlũ makĩheana ũhoro wa ciama na morirũ iria Ngai eekĩte kũrĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ agereire harĩo.
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩhĩtũka Misia, magĩikũrũka magĩkinya Teroa.
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

kikuyu: Paũlũ aarĩkia kuona kĩoneki kĩu, tũkĩĩhaarĩria o hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩgeetha tũthiĩ Makedonia, tũgĩtua atĩ Ngai nĩatwĩtĩte tũkamahunjĩrie Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega.
english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ene mũirĩtu ũcio ngombo maamenyire atĩ mwĩhoko wao wa kuona mbeeca nĩwathira, makĩnyiita Paũlũ na Sila makĩmaguucũrũria makĩmatoonyia ndũnyũ mbere ya aathani.
english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

kikuyu: Makĩmarehe mbere ya aciirithania, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Andũ aya nĩ Ayahudi, na nĩmararehe ngũĩ itũũra-inĩ riitũ
english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

kikuyu: No Paũlũ akĩanĩrĩra, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndũkeegere ngero! Ithuothe tũrĩ ho!”
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akiuga marutũrũrwo kuumaigooti-inĩ.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

kikuyu: HĩndĩĩyoAyahudiacioothemakĩgarũrũkĩraSosithenemũtongoriawathunagogi, na makĩmũhũũrĩra hau mbere ya igooti. No Galio ndaigana kũrũmbũyania na ũhoro ũcio o na atĩa.
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

kikuyu: Na thuutha wa Paũlũ gũikaranga kũu Antiokia, akiuma kuo, na agĩthiĩ kũndũ na kũndũ bũrũri wothe wa Galatia na Firigia, akĩũmagĩrĩria arutwo othe.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Paũlũ akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mwakĩbatithirio ũbatithio ũrĩkũ?” Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Twabatithirio ũbatithio wa Johana.”
english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

kikuyu: Nao othe maarĩ ta andũ ikũmi na eerĩ.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

kikuyu: No amwe ao makĩũmia ngoro; makĩaga gwĩtĩkia na magĩcambia Njĩra ĩyo mbere ya kĩrĩndĩ. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Paũlũ akĩmeherera. Akĩoya arutwo agĩthiĩ nao nyũmba ĩrĩa yathomithagĩrio andũ ya Turano, akaaranagĩria na andũ o mũthenya arĩ kuo.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

kikuyu: Nake agĩcookanĩrĩria andũ acio maaturaga indo icio, hamwe na aruti a wĩra arĩa maarutaga wĩra ũhaanaine na wao, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Andũ aya, inyuĩ nĩmũũĩ nĩtuonaga uumithio mũnene kuuma kũrĩ wonjoria ũyũ.
english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

kikuyu: Karani wa kĩama gĩa itũũra rĩu agĩkiria kĩrĩndĩ kĩu, agĩcooka akĩmeera atĩrĩ: “Andũ aya a Efeso, githĩ thĩ yothe ndĩũĩ atĩ itũũra rĩa Efeso nĩrĩo rĩene hekarũ ĩrĩa ĩtũũragwo nĩ Aritemi ũrĩa mũnene, na mũhianano wake ũrĩa waharũrũkire kuuma igũrũ?
english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

kikuyu: Aarĩkia kuuga ũguo, akĩĩra kĩũngano kĩu gĩthiĩ, akĩniina mũcemanio.
english: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

kikuyu: Nĩ kwarĩ na matawa maingĩ maakanaga kũu nyũmba ya igũrũ kũrĩa twagomanĩte.
english: There were many lights in the upper room where we† were gathered together.

kikuyu: Twaarĩkia kuganĩra ũhoro, tũkĩhaica marikabu, nao makĩinũka.
english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

kikuyu: Twoima Turo, tũgĩthiĩ na mbere na rũgendo rwitũ, tũgĩkinya Putolemai, tũkĩgeithia ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ kuo na tũgĩikarania nao mũthenya ũmwe.
english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

kikuyu: Ha ũhoro wa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ arĩa metĩkĩtie-rĩ, nĩtwamandĩkĩire, tũkĩmamenyithia itua riitũ, atĩ o metheeme kũrĩa irio iria irutĩirwo mĩhianano, na thakame, na nyama cia nyamũ cia gũitwo, o na ũmaraya.”
english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

kikuyu: Nake o rĩmwe akĩoya anene na thigari magĩikũrũka harĩ kĩrĩndĩ matengʼerete. Rĩrĩa andũ acio maarutaga ngũĩ moonire mũnene ũcio na thigari ciake magĩtiga kũhũũra Paũlũ.
english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Paũlũ aakinyire ngathĩ-inĩ kĩrĩndĩ kĩu gĩgĩthũka mũno o nginya Paũlũ agĩkuuo nĩ thigari.
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

kikuyu: Ūndū-inī ta ūyū, rūūru rwothe no rūheo njanjo, na rīngī thutha-inī rūage hinya mūiganu wa kūīgitīra kuuma na mūrimū.
english: In this situation, the flock may be effectively vaccinated, but the immunity is insufficient to protect against the disease completely

kikuyu: Thutha ūcio ngūkū ici nīireragwo na njīra ya kwagīrithia maūthī maya.
english: The chickens are then reared in a way that makes these characteristics even better.

kikuyu: Nīiteithagia kweheria indo iria ciatigio, gūthondeka fertilizer ya ndūire, kweheria tūnyamū tūrīa tūthūkagia mīgūnda, gūteithīrīria wīra wa gūbūthia indo, na gūtuhe matumbī mega.
english: They help eliminate scraps, produce a natural fertiliser, get rid of pesky garden pests, assist with composting and provide fresh, free-range eggs!

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Adamu ciarĩ Sethi, na Enoshu,
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

kikuyu: na Enoku, na Methusela, na Lameku, na Nuhu.
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

kikuyu: Ariũ a Jafethu maarĩ: Gomeri, na Magogu, na Madai, na Javani, na Tubali, na Mesheki, na Tirasi.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Javani maarĩ: Elisha, na Tarishishi, na Kitimu, na Rodanimu.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Hamu maarĩ: Kushi, na Miziraimu, na Putu, na Kaanani.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

kikuyu: Ici nĩcio njiaro ciao: Nebaiothu nĩwe warĩ irigithathi rĩa Ishumaeli, nao ariũ ake arĩa angĩ maarĩ Kedari, na Adibeeli, na Mibisamu,
english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

kikuyu: na Mishima, na Duma, na Masa, na Hadadi, na Tema,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jobabu aakuire, Hushamu wa kuuma bũrũri wa Atemani agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Hadadi o nake agĩkua. Anene a Edomu maarĩ:
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Ethani aarĩ: Azaria.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

kikuyu: na Ozemu wa gatandatũ, nake Daudi aarĩ wa mũgwanja.
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

kikuyu: Segubu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Jairu, ũrĩa warĩ na matũũra mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na matatũ kũu Gileadi.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: (No rĩrĩ, Geshuru na Aramu magĩtunyana matũũra ma Havothu-Jairu, o hamwe na Kenathu na ciikaro iria ciarĩthiũrũrũkĩirie, namo maarĩ matũũra mĩrongo ĩtandatũ.) Aya othe nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Makiru, o we ithe wa Gileadi.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa Hezironi gũkua arĩ kũu Kalebu-Efiratha-rĩ, Abija mũtumia wa Hezironi akĩmũciarĩra Ashuru, ithe wa Tekoa.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

kikuyu: Jerameeli aarĩ na mũtumia ũngĩ wetagwo Atara, nake nĩwe warĩ nyina wa Onamu.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Jada, mũrũ wa nyina na Shamai, maarĩ: Jetheri na Jonathani. Jetheri aakuire atarĩ na ciana.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Kalebu. Ariũ a Huru, irigithathi rĩa Efiratha, maarĩ: Shobali ithe wa Kiriathu-Jearimu,
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

kikuyu: Nake Jabezu agĩkaĩra Ngai wa Isiraeli, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Naarĩ korwo wandathima na ũnjaramĩrie mĩhaka ya bũrũri wakwa! Reke guoko gwaku gũkorwo hamwe na niĩ, na ũngitĩre harĩ ũũru nĩguo ndikanakorwo na ruo.” Nake Ngai akĩigua ihooya rĩake. *
english: Jabez called on the God‡ of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa marĩĩtwa mao maandĩkĩtwo mookĩte kuo matukũ-inĩ ma Hezekia mũthamaki wa Juda. Nao magĩtharĩkĩra andũ a Hamu ciikaro-inĩ cia andũ acio o na cia Ameunimu arĩa maatũũraga kuo, na makĩmaniina biũ o ta ũrĩa gũtariĩ nginya ũmũthĩ. Nao magĩtũũra ciikaro-inĩ cia andũ acio tondũ kwarĩ na ũrĩithio mwega wa mahiũ mao.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

kikuyu: ariũ a Rubeni, irigithathi rĩa Isiraeli, maarĩ: Hanoku, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: Aya nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao: Eferi, na Ishi, na Elieli, na Azirieli, na Jeremia, na Hodavia, na Jahadieli. Maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao, na njamba cia ita, na andũ marĩ igweta.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: na Abishua nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Buki, na Buki nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Uzi,
english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

kikuyu: na Meraiothu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Amaria, na Amaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahitubu,
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: na Johanani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Azaria (ũrĩa watungataga arĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ĩrĩa Solomoni aakire kũu Jerusalemu),
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: na Azaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Amaria, na Amaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahitubu,
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Jehozadaku nĩathaamirio hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Jehova aarekereirie andũ a Juda na a Jerusalemu matahwo nĩ Nebukadinezaru.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: nake Eliabu aarĩ mũriũ wa Nahathu, nake Jerohamu aarĩ mũriũ wa Eliabu, nake Elikana aarĩ mũriũ wa Jerohamu, nake Samũeli aarĩ mũriũ wa Elikana.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Samũeli maarĩ: Joeli irigithathi, na mũriũ wa keerĩ aarĩ Abija.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

kikuyu: Aya nĩo andũ arĩa Daudi aatuire arũgamĩrĩri a ũini nyũmba-inĩ ya Jehova thuutha wa ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro gũkinya kũu.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house after the ark came to rest there.

kikuyu: Aya nĩo andũ arĩa maarutaga wĩra, hamwe na ariũ ao: Kuuma kũrĩ Akohathu maarĩ: Hemani ũrĩa mũini, mũrũ wa Joeli, mũrũ wa Samũeli,
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

kikuyu: mũrũ wa Tahathu, mũrũ wa Asiru, mũrũ wa Ebiasafu, mũrũ wa Kora,
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

kikuyu: na Ashani, na Juta, na Bethi-Shemeshu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: na Ramothu, na Anemu, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo;
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: na Heshiboni, na Jazeri, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Bekeri maarĩ: Zemira, na Joashu, na Eliezeri, na Elioenai, na Omuri, na Jeremothu, na Abija, na Anathothu, na Alemethu. Acio othe maarĩ ariũ a Bekeri.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

kikuyu: Ithe wao Efiraimu nĩamacakaĩire mĩthenya mĩingĩ, nao andũ ao magĩũka kũmũhooreria.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Zofa maarĩ: Sua, na Harineferi, na Shuali, na Beri, na Imura,
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

kikuyu: na Abishua, na Naamani, na Ahoa,
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

kikuyu: Mũtumia wake Hushimu akĩmũciarĩra Ahitubu na Elipaali.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

kikuyu: na Elienai, na Zilethai, na Elieli,
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

kikuyu: Andũ a kuuma Benjamini, ta ũrĩa maandĩkĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa ciao, maarĩ 956. Arũme acio othe maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: na Azaria mũrũ wa Hilikia, mũrũ wa Meshulamu, mũrũ wa Zadoku, mũrũ wa Meraiothu, mũrũ wa Ahitubu ũrĩa warĩ mũmenyereri mũnene wa nyũmba ya Ngai;
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

kikuyu: Arangĩri a ihingo maarĩ: Shalumu, na Akubu, na Talimoni, na Ahimani na ariũ a nyina, na Shalumu mũnene wao,
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

kikuyu: Maikaraga ũtukũ wothe hakuhĩ na nyũmba ya Ngai nĩgeetha mamĩrangagĩre; na nĩo maamenyagĩrĩra cabi ya kũmĩhingũra o rũciinĩ.*
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

kikuyu: Arĩa maarĩ aini, na atongoria a nyũmba cia Alawii, maaikaraga tũnyũmba-inĩ kũu hekarũ thĩinĩ na matiarutaga mawĩra mangĩ tondũ maarĩ a kũmenyerera wĩra ũcio wao mũthenya na ũtukũ.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

kikuyu: Afilisti makĩhatĩrĩria Saũlũ na ariũ ake mũno, na makĩũraga ariũ ake Jonathani, na Abinadabu, na Maliki-Shua.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mbaara nĩyaneneheire Saũlũ mũno, na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aikia a mĩguĩ maamũkinyĩrire, makĩmũguraria.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: Maya nĩmo marĩĩtwa ma andũ acio maarĩ njamba a Daudi: Jashobeamu ũrĩa Mũhakimoni nake aarĩ mũtongoria wa anene; nĩwe woire itimũ rĩake ahũũrane na andũ 300, nake akĩmooraga mbaara-inĩ ĩmwe.
english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ acio atatũ magĩtuĩkanĩria gatagatĩ ka ita rĩaAfilisti, magĩtahamaaĩgĩthima-inĩkĩukĩarĩhakuhĩnakĩhingokĩaBethilehemu, namakĩmatwarĩra Daudi. No Daudi akĩrega kũmanyua; akĩmaita mbere ya Jehova.
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,

kikuyu: Abishai mũrũ wa nyina na Joabu nĩwe warĩ mũnene wa acio Atatũ. Nake akĩoya itimũ rĩake, agĩtharĩkĩra andũ magana matatũ, akĩmooraga, nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩgĩa igweta o ta acio Atatũ.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

kikuyu: na Maharai ũrĩa Mũnetofathi, na Helebu mũrũ wa Baana ũrĩa Mũnetofathi,
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

kikuyu: Ahiezeri ũrĩa warĩ mũnene wao na Joashu, ariũ a Shemaa ũrĩa Mũgibea; na Jezieli, na Peleti, ariũ a Azimavethu; na Beraka, na Jehu ũrĩa Mũanathothu,
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Daudi aathiire Zikilagi, aya nĩo andũ a Manase arĩa maagarũrũkire magĩthiĩ mwena wake: Adina, na Jozabadu, na Jediaeli, na Mikaeli, na Jozabadu, na Elihu, na Zilethai, atongoria a ikundi cia ngiri kũu Manase.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ andũ a kũrũa arĩa meerutĩte gũtungata marĩ ita-inĩ. Magĩũka Hebironi marĩ na ngoro ĩmwe ya gũtua Daudi mũthamaki wa Isiraeli guothe. Andũ a Isiraeli arĩa angĩ othe o nao maarĩ na rĩciiria o rĩmwe rĩa gũtua Daudi mũthamaki.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

kikuyu: Nĩtũrehei ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro rĩa Ngai witũ tũrĩcookie kũrĩ ithuĩ, nĩgũkorwo tũtiatuĩragia ũhoro harĩ rĩo hĩndĩ ya ũthamaki wa Saũlũ.”
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

kikuyu: Nake Daudi nĩamenyire atĩ Jehova nĩamũhaandĩte atuĩke mũthamaki wa Isiraeli, na atĩ ũthamaki wake nĩwatũũgĩrĩtio mũno nĩ ũndũ wa andũ ake a Isiraeli.
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

kikuyu: Afilisti nĩmatharĩkĩire Gĩtuamba kĩu rĩngĩ;
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ inyuĩ, Alawii, mũtiarĩambatirie ihinda rĩa mbere, nĩkĩo Jehova Ngai witũ aatũũkĩrĩire na marakara. Tũtiigana gũtuĩria ũhoro wa ũrĩa tũngĩekire kũrĩ we, kũringana na ũrĩa gwatuĩtwo.”
english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

kikuyu: Tondũ Ngai nĩateithĩtie Alawii arĩa maakuuaga ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova-rĩ, ndegwa mũgwanja na ndũrũme mũgwanja nĩciarutirwo igongona.
english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ othe a Isiraeli makĩambatia ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova makĩanagĩrĩra, makĩhuhaga macoro na tũrumbeta, na makĩhũũrithanagia thaani iria ihũũrithanagio na ikagamba, na makĩhũũraga inanda cia kĩnũbi na cia mũgeeto.
english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

kikuyu: Alawii makĩrehe ithandũkũ rĩa Ngai, makĩrĩtoonyia thĩinĩ wa hema ĩrĩa yaambĩtwo nĩ Daudi nĩ ũndũ warĩo, na makĩrutĩra Ngai maruta ma njino na maruta ma ũiguano.
english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

kikuyu: nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai, Benaia na Jahazieli, maarĩ a kũhuha tũrumbeta hĩndĩ ciothe marĩ mbere ya ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Ngai.
english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

kikuyu: Rĩu nĩwonete kwagĩrĩire ũrathime nyũmba ya ndungata yaku, nĩgeetha ĩtũũre nginya tene maitho-inĩ maku; nĩgũkorwo, Wee Jehova nĩũmĩrathimĩte, na ĩgũtũũra ĩrĩ ndaathime nginya tene.”
english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

kikuyu: Joabu nĩonire atĩ thigari nĩciaranĩtio mbere yake o na thuutha wake; nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩthuura mbũtũ imwe iria njega mũno kũu Isiraeli, agĩcitũma ikarũe na Asuriata.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa Asuriata kuona atĩ nĩmatoorio nĩ andũ a Isiraeli, magĩtũma andũ makarehithie Asuriata a kuuma mũrĩmo wa Rũũĩ rwa Farati matongoretio nĩ Shofaku ũrĩa warĩ mũnene wa mbũtũ cia ita cia Hadadezeri.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River,‡ with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

kikuyu: Mbaara-inĩ ĩngĩ makĩrũa na Afilisti, nake Elihanani mũrũ wa Jairu akĩũraga Lahami mũrũ wa nyina na Goliathũ, ũrĩa Mũgiiti, ũrĩa warĩ na itimũ rĩarĩ na mũtĩ waiganaga ta mũtĩ wa mũtumi ngoora.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Rafa wa kũu Gathu, nao makĩũragwo nĩ Daudi na andũ ake.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi akĩĩra Joabu na anene a mbũtũ cia ita atĩrĩ: “Thiĩi mũgatare andũ a Isiraeli kuuma Birishiba nginya Dani, mũcooke mũndehere ũhoro nĩguo menye ũrĩa maigana.”
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Gadi ũrĩa woonagĩra Daudi maũndũ atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Arauna aakonyoraga ngano-rĩ, akĩĩhũgũra akĩona mũraika ũcio; nao ariũ ake ana arĩa maarĩ nake makĩĩhitha.
english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo wee nĩũkagaacĩra, ũngĩgatuĩka wa kũmenyagĩrĩra kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo o na watho ũrĩa Jehova aaheire Musa nĩ ũndũ wa Isiraeli. Gĩa na hinya na ũmĩrĩrie. Ndũgetigĩre kana ũkue ngoro.
english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

kikuyu: “Nĩndutĩte wĩra mũnene wa kũhaarĩria mwako wa hekarũ ya Jehova, ngaigithia taranda 100,000† cia thahabu, na taranda 1,000,000‡ cia betha, na icango nyingĩ na igera nyingĩ itangĩthimĩka, na mbaũ na mahiga. Nawe no wongerere ingĩ.
english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents† of gold, one million talents‡ of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Daudi agĩatha atongoria othe a Isiraeli mateithie mũriũ Solomoni.
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

kikuyu: Alawii arĩa maakinyĩtie mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ kana makĩria magĩtarwo, nao arũme othe maarĩ 38,000.
english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

kikuyu: Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Thĩinĩ wa aya, 24,000 nĩ marũgamagĩrĩre wĩra wa hekarũ ya Jehova, nao 6,000 matuĩke anene na atuithania a ciira.
english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

kikuyu: Daudi nĩagayanirie Alawii acio ikundi kũringana na ariũ a Lawi na nĩo Gerishoni, na Kohathu, na Merari.
english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Shimei maarĩ: Shelomothu, na Hazieli, na Harani, othe maarĩ atatũ. Acio nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia Ladani.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Gerishomu nĩ: Shebueli nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

kikuyu: Na nĩ ũndũ ũcio Alawii magĩthiĩ na mbere kũruta wĩra ũrĩa mehokeirwo wa Hema-ya- Gũtũnganwo, na wa Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru, matongoretio nĩ ariũ a ithe wao a rũciaro rwa Harũni, nĩ ũndũ wa ũtungata wa hekarũ ya Jehova.
english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Rehabia: nĩ Ishia na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

kikuyu: O mũthenya gwakoragwo na Alawii atandatũ mwena wa irathĩro, na Alawii ana mwena wa gathigathini, na Alawii ana mwena wa gũthini, na Alawii eerĩ mahinda mothe nyũmba-inĩ ya kũigwo-indo.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Iziharu: Kenania na ariũ ake nĩmaheirwo mawĩra na kũu nja ya hekarũ matuĩke anene na aciirithania a Isiraeli.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo mũtaratara wa andũ a Isiraeli arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba, na anene a ikundi cia o ngiri ngiri na ikundi cia o igana igana, na anene ao, arĩa maatungatagĩra mũthamaki maũndũ-inĩ mothe makoniĩ ikundi cia mbũtũ cia ita iria ciakoragwo wĩra-inĩ mweri o mweri, mwaka wothe. O gĩkundi kĩarĩ kĩa andũ 24,000.
english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Dani aarĩ Azareli mũrũ wa Jerohamu; Acio nĩo maarĩ anene arĩa maathaga mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli.
english: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Maũndũ maya mothe ndĩmandĩkĩte ũrĩa ndatongoririo nĩ guoko kwa Jehova kũrĩ igũrũ rĩakwa, na akĩĩhe ũmenyo wa maũndũ mothe ma mũcoro ũyũ.”
english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Ngai witũ, nĩtũgũgũcookeria ngaatho, na tũkagooca rĩĩtwa rĩaku rĩrĩ riiri.
english: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

kikuyu: Naho ha maũndũ marĩa makoniĩ wathani wa Mũthamaki Daudi kuuma kĩambĩrĩria nginya mũthia, nĩmandĩkĩtwo thĩinĩ wa maandĩko ma Samũeli ũrĩa warĩ muoni-maũndũ, na maandĩko-inĩ ma Nathani ũrĩa mũnabii na maandĩko-inĩ ma Gadi ũrĩa muoni-maũndũ,
english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

kikuyu: Nake Solomoni na kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe makĩambata kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru kũu Gibeoni, nĩgũkorwo Hema- ya-Gũtũnganwo ya Ngai nĩkuo yarĩ, ĩrĩa Musa ndungata ya Jehova aathondekeire kũu werũ-inĩ.
english: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which Yahweh’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Wee Jehova Ngai, reke ũrĩa werĩire baba Daudi ũhinge, nĩgũkorwo nĩũnduĩte mũthamaki wa andũ aingĩ o ta rũkũngũ rwa thĩ.
english: Now, Yahweh God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki nĩatũmire betha na thahabu cingĩhe Jerusalemu o ta mahiga, mĩtarakwa nayo yarĩ mĩingĩ o ta mĩkũyũ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ magũrũ-inĩ ma irĩma.
english: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

kikuyu: Nĩngaahe ndungata ciaku iria ciatũũraga mbaũ kori 20,000* cia mũtu wa ngano, na kori 20,000 cia cairi, na mbathi 20,000† cia ndibei, na mbathi 20,000 cia maguta ma mĩtamaiyũ.”
english: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors‡ of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths§ of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

kikuyu: “Nĩngũgũtũmĩra Huramu-Abi, mũndũ mũũgĩ mũno na wĩra,
english: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,†

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Solomoni akĩambĩrĩria gwaka hekarũ ya Jehova kũu Jerusalemu Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Moria,* harĩa Jehova oimĩrĩire ithe Daudi. Hau nĩho kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano kĩa Arauna ũrĩa Mũjebusi, handũ harĩa Daudi aaheanĩte hekarũ ĩgaakwo.
english: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩaka itangi inene mũno rĩrĩa rĩetagwo Karia rĩa kĩgera gĩtwekie, na rĩarĩ rĩa gĩthiũrũrĩ, na rĩarĩ rĩa mĩkono ikũmi kuuma mwena ũmwe wa mũromo nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ, na mĩkono ĩtano‡ kũraiha na igũrũ. Rĩathimwo gĩthiũrũrĩ kĩarĩo rĩathiũrũrũkĩirio nĩ rũrigi rwa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtatũ.§
english: Also he made the molten sea‡ of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

kikuyu: “Kũngĩkaagĩa ngʼaragu kana mũthiro bũrũri-inĩ, kana mĩgũnda ĩhĩe nĩ mbaa kana mbuu, kana gũũke ngigĩ kana ngũnga, kana thũ imarigiicĩrie itũũra-inĩ rĩmwe rĩao, na mwanangĩko o na ũrĩkũ kana mũrimũ ũngĩgooka-rĩ,
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo ũrĩ o kũu igũrũ gĩikaro-inĩ gĩaku, ũkaigua ihooya rĩao na mathaithana mao na ũmatirĩrĩre ũhoro-inĩ ũcio wao. Na ũkaarekera andũ aku, o acio makwĩhĩirie.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ, ihinda rĩrĩa Solomoni aahũthĩrire gwaka hekarũ ya Jehova o na nyũmba yake ya ũthamaki-rĩ,
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house and his own house,

kikuyu: Kaĩ gũkena nĩ andũ aku-ĩ! Ningĩ gũkena nĩ anene aku arĩa marũgamaga mbere yaku hĩndĩ ciothe makaiguaga ũũgĩ waku!
english: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩthondeka ngo 300 cia thahabu hũũre, o ĩmwe yathondeketwo na thahabu ya ũritũ wa beka 300.§ Mũthamaki agĩciiga Nyũmba ya Ũthamaki ĩrĩa yetagwo Mũtitũ wa Lebanoni.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels§ of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Gĩtĩ kĩu kĩa ũnene kĩarĩ na ngathĩ ya makinya matandatũ, na gaturwa ga thahabu ga gũkinyithia magũrũ kanyiitithanĩtio nakĩo. Mĩena- inĩ yeerĩ ya gĩtĩ kĩu yarĩ na handũ ha kũigĩrĩra moko, na nĩ haarĩ na mĩhiano ya mĩrũũthi ĩrũgamĩte mĩena-inĩ yeerĩ ya moko macio.
english: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ mũngĩndaara atĩa? Andũ acio maranjĩĩra ũũ, ‘Tũhũthĩrie icooki rĩrĩa thoguo aatũigĩrĩire.’ Tũngĩmacookeria atĩa?”
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

kikuyu: Nĩatũmĩrire ũũgĩ, akĩhurunjĩra ariũ ake amwe ngʼongo-inĩ ciothe cia Juda na Benjamini, na akĩmahurunjĩra matũũra-inĩ mothe manene marĩa maarĩ mairigĩre. Nĩamaheire mĩthiithũ mĩiganu, na akĩmacarĩria o mũndũ atumia aingĩ.
english: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.

kikuyu: Tondũ wa gũkorwo matarĩ ehokeku harĩ Jehova, Shishaka mũthamaki wa Misiri nĩatharĩkĩire Jerusalemu mwaka wa gatano wa Mũthamaki Rehoboamu.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Yahweh,

kikuyu: agĩtaha matũũra manene marĩa maarĩ mairigĩre ma Juda na agĩthiĩ nginya Jerusalemu.
english: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jehova onire atĩ nĩmenyiihĩtie-rĩ, ndũmĩrĩri ĩno ya Jehova ĩgĩkinyĩra Shemaia akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ: “Kuona atĩ nĩmenyiihĩtie-rĩ, ndikũmananga no nĩngũmahonokia o narua. Mangʼũrĩ makwa matigũitĩrĩrio Jerusalemu na kũhũthĩra guoko gwa Shishaka.
english: When Yahweh saw that they humbled themselves, Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

kikuyu: Nĩekire maũndũ mooru tondũ ndaatuĩte na ngoro yake kũrongooria Jehova.
english: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mwaka wa ikũmi na ĩnana wa ũthamaki wa Jeroboamu nĩguo Abija aatuĩkire mũthamaki wa Juda,
english: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩũngania andũ othe a Juda na a Benjamini, hamwe na andũ a kuuma Efiraimu, na Manase, na Simeoni arĩa maatũũranagia nao, nĩgũkorwo aingĩ ao nĩmookĩte kũrĩ Asa moimĩte Isiraeli rĩrĩa moonire atĩ Jehova Ngai wake aarĩ hamwe nake.
english: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.

kikuyu: Maũndũ ma wathani wa Asa kuuma kĩambĩrĩria nginya mũthia, nĩmandĩkĩtwo mbuku-inĩ ya athamaki a Juda na Isiraeli.
english: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

kikuyu: Nĩerutĩire na ngoro yake kũrũmĩrĩra mĩthiĩre ya Jehova; na makĩria ma ũguo, agĩtharia kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru o na itugĩ cia Ashera, agĩcieheria Juda.
english: His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthamaki wa Isiraeli agĩĩta ũmwe wa anene ake, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndehera Mikaia mũrũ wa Imula narua.”
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”

kikuyu: Mikaia agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Nĩũkamenya mũthenya ũrĩa ũgaathiĩ kwĩhitha kanyũmba ka na thĩinĩ.”
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa anene a mbũtũ cia ngaari cia ita moonire Jehoshafatu magĩĩciiria atĩrĩ, “Ũyũ nĩwe mũthamaki wa Isiraeli” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩgarũrũka mamũtharĩkĩre, no Jehoshafatu agĩkaya, nake Jehova akĩmũteithia. Ngai akĩmaroria na kũngĩ, makĩmweherera,
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahweh helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

kikuyu: Jehu ũrĩa muoni-maũndũ, mũrũ wa Hanani, agĩthiĩ akamũtũnge nake akĩũria mũthamaki atĩrĩ, “Nĩwagĩrĩirwo gũteithia mũndũ ũrĩa mwaganu na wende arĩa mathũire Jehova? Nĩ ũndũ wa ũguo-rĩ, mangʼũrĩ ma Jehova marĩ igũrũ rĩaku.
english: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate Yahweh? Because of this, wrath is on you from before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehoshafatu na andũ ake magĩthiĩ gũtaha indo, na thĩinĩ wacio makĩona indo nyingĩ na nguo o na indo cia goro nyingĩ gũkĩra ũrĩa mangĩahotire gũkuua. Ciarĩ nyingĩ ũũ atĩ maaniinire mĩthenya ĩtatũ gũciũngania.
english: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. They took plunder for three days, it was so much.

kikuyu: Naguo ũthamaki wa Jehoshafatu ũgĩikara ũrĩ na thayũ, nĩgũkorwo Ngai wake nĩamũheete ũhurũko mĩena-inĩ yothe.
english: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.

kikuyu: Jehoramu aarĩ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ĩĩrĩ rĩrĩa aatuĩkire mũthamaki, nake aathamakire arĩ Jerusalemu mĩaka ĩnana. Na rĩrĩ, akua gũtirĩ mũndũ wagĩire na kĩeha, nake agĩthikwo Itũũra Inene rĩa Daudi, no ndaathikirwo mbĩrĩra-inĩ cia athamaki.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.

kikuyu: gĩcunjĩ gĩa gatatũ kĩanyu mũrangĩre nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na gĩcunjĩ gĩa gatatũ mũrangĩre kĩhingo kĩa mũthingi, nao andũ acio angĩ othe maikare nja cia hekarũ ya Jehova.
english: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Mũtikanareke mũndũ o na ũmwe atoonye hekarũ ya Jehova tiga o athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii arĩa marĩ wĩra-inĩ; acio no matoonye tondũ nĩ aamũre, no andũ acio angĩ othe marangĩre kĩrĩa Jehova oigĩte marangĩre.
english: But let no one come into Yahweh’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow Yahweh’s instructions.

kikuyu: Arĩa maagĩire ndundu mamũũkĩrĩre maarĩ Zabadi mũrũ wa Shimeathu mũndũ-wa-nja Mũamoni, na Jehozabadu mũrũ wa Shimurithu mũndũ-wa-nja Mũmoabi.
english: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa Amazia mũthamaki wa Juda kũhooya kĩrĩra kuuma kũrĩ ataari ake-rĩ, agĩtũma ndũmĩrĩri ĩno ya njũgitano kũrĩ Jehoashu mũrũ wa Jehoahazu, mũrũ wa Jehu mũthamaki wa Isiraeli, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ: “Ũka, tũcemanie, tuonane ũthiũ kwa ũthiũ.”
english: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”

kikuyu: Agĩcookio aigĩrĩirwo mbarathi igũrũ, na agĩthikwo hamwe na maithe Itũũra-inĩ Inene rĩa Juda.
english: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.

kikuyu: Ningĩ andũ othe a Juda makĩoya Uzia, arĩ wa mĩaka ikũmi na ĩtandatũ, na makĩmũtua mũthamaki ithenya rĩa ithe Amazia.
english: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

kikuyu: Nĩarongooragia Ngai matukũ-inĩ ma Zekaria, ũrĩa wamũrutĩte gwĩtigĩra Ngai. Narĩo ihinda rĩrĩa rĩothe aarongoragia Jehova-rĩ, Ngai nĩamũheaga ũgaacĩru.
english: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper.

kikuyu: Ngai akĩmũteithia kũhũũrana na Afilisti na Arabu arĩa maatũũraga Guri-Baali na Ameuni.
english: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

kikuyu: Wathani-inĩ wao haarĩ na mbũtũ ya ita ya andũ 307,500 arĩa maarutĩtwo ũhoro wa mbaara, mbũtũ ĩyo yarĩ na hinya na nĩyo yateithagia mũthamaki akĩrũa na thũ ciake.
english: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

kikuyu: Zikiri ũrĩa Mũefiraimu njamba ya ita akĩũraga Maaseia mũrũ wa mũthamaki, na Azirikamu ũrĩa warĩ mũmenyereri wa nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na Elikana ũrĩa warĩ wa keerĩ kuuma harĩ mũthamaki.
english: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũciirĩire gũtua arũme na andũ-a-nja a Juda na Jerusalemu ngombo cianyu. No githĩ o na inyuĩ mũtihĩtĩtie na mũkehĩria Jehova Ngai wanyu?
english: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against Yahweh your God?

kikuyu: Nake Tigilathu-Pileseru mũthamaki wa Ashuri agĩũka kũrĩ we, no handũ ha kũmũteithia nĩkũmũthĩĩnia aamũthĩĩnirie.
english: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.

kikuyu: kuuma kũrĩ njiaro cia Elizafani, maarĩ Shimuri na Jeieli; kuuma kũrĩ njiaro cia Asafu, maarĩ Zekaria na Matania;
english: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

kikuyu: Hezekia agĩathana atĩ kũrutwo iruta rĩa njino kĩgongona-inĩ. Narĩo igongona rĩambĩrĩria kũrutwo-rĩ, andũ makĩambĩrĩria kũinĩra Jehova marĩ na tũrumbeta na inanda cia kũina cia Daudi mũthamaki wa Isiraeli.
english: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Hezekia akiuga atĩrĩ, “Rĩu nĩmweyamũrĩra Jehova. Rehei magongona na maruta ma gũcookia ngaatho hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio kĩũngano kĩu gĩkĩrehe magongona na maruta ma gũcookia ngaatho, na andũ othe arĩa ngoro ciao cieyendeire makĩrehe maruta ma njino.
english: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to Yahweh. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into Yahweh’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

kikuyu: Nake Hezekia na andũ othe magĩkena nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa Ngai eekĩire andũ ake, tondũ ũndũ ũcio wekirwo narua mũno.
english: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

kikuyu: Athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii makĩrũgama, makĩrathima andũ, nake Ngai akĩmaigua, nĩgũkorwo ihooya rĩao nĩrĩakinyire o igũrũ, gĩikaro gĩake gĩtheru.
english: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.

kikuyu: Hezekia agĩkĩiga athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii na ikundi, o gĩkundi kũringana na wĩra wakĩo, marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai kana Alawii, marutage maruta ma njino na ma ũiguano, ningĩ matungatage, na macookagie ngaatho, na mainage nyĩmbo cia ũgooci marĩ ihingo-inĩ cia gĩikaro kĩa Jehova.
english: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of Yahweh’s camp.

kikuyu: Ha ũhoro wa athĩnjĩri-Ngai, o acio a rũciaro rwa Harũni, arĩa maatũũraga mĩgũnda-inĩ ĩrĩa yathiũrũrũkĩirie matũũra mao kana matũũra mangĩ, nĩ kwarĩ na andũ amwe maathuurĩtwo na makagwetwo marĩĩtwa a kũgaĩra arũme othe arĩa maarĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ kao rũgai rwao, na kũrĩ arĩa othe maandĩkĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa cia Alawii.
english: Also for the sons of Aaron the priests, who were in the fields of the pasture lands of their cities, in every city, there were men who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogy among the Levites.

kikuyu: magĩciira na anene ake o na atongoria a thigari cia ita ũrĩa mekũhingĩrĩria maaĩ kuuma ithima-inĩ cia nja ya itũũra inene, nao makĩmũteithia.
english: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.

kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio, rĩrĩa Senakeribu mũthamaki wa Ashuri na mbũtũ ciake ciothe maathiũrũrũkĩirie Lakishi, agĩtũma anene ake Jerusalemu matwarĩre Hezekia mũthamaki wa Juda, o na andũ othe a Juda arĩa maarĩ kuo, ndũmĩrĩri ĩno:
english: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: Ndungata cia Senakeribu igĩthiĩ o na mbere kwaria mĩario ya gũũkĩrĩra Jehova Ngai o na gũũkĩrĩra ndungata yake Hezekia.
english: His servants spoke yet more against Yahweh God and against his servant Hezekiah.

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũthamaki akĩandĩka marũa ma kũruma Jehova, Ngai wa Isiraeli akĩmũũkĩrĩra, akiuga atĩrĩ, “O ta ũrĩa ngai cia ndũrĩrĩ cia mabũrũri marĩa mangĩ itaahotire kũhonokia andũ acio kuuma guoko-inĩ gwakwa-rĩ, noguo ngai ya Hezekia ĩtekũhota kũhonokia andũ ayo kuuma moko-inĩ makwa.”
english: He also wrote letters insulting Yahweh, the God of Israel, and speaking against him, saying, “As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Hezekiah not deliver his people out of my hand.”

kikuyu: Mũthamaki Hezekia na mũnabii Isaia mũrũ wa Amozu makĩhooya manĩrĩire magĩkaĩra ũrĩa ũrĩ igũrũ nĩ ũndũ wa ũhoro ũcio.
english: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.

kikuyu: Andũ aingĩ magĩtwarĩra Jehova indo cia maruta kũu Jerusalemu, na magĩtwarĩra Hezekia mũthamaki wa Juda iheo cia goro. Kuuma hĩndĩ ĩyo agĩtuĩka mũndũ mũtĩĩku mũno nĩ ndũrĩrĩ ciothe.
english: Many brought gifts to Yahweh to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from then on.

kikuyu: HĩndĩĩyoHezekiaakĩĩriramehiama mwĩtĩĩo wangoroyake, ota ũrĩaandũaJerusalemu meekire, nĩ ũndũ ũcio mangʼũrĩ ma Jehova makĩaga kũmakinyĩrĩra matukũ-inĩ ma Hezekia.
english: However, Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that Yahweh’s wrath didn’t come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa abarũthi maatũmirwo kũrĩ we nĩ aathani a Babuloni mamũũrie ũhoro wa rũũri rwa kĩmenyithia rũrĩa ruonekete bũrũri-inĩ-rĩ, Ngai akĩmũtiganĩria nĩguo amũgerie amenye maũndũ marĩa mothe maarĩ ngoro-inĩ yake.
english: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa mangĩ makoniĩ wathani wa Hezekia na wĩrutĩri wake nĩmandĩkĩtwo kĩoneki- inĩ kĩa mũnabii Isaia mũrũ wa Amozu, thĩinĩ wa ibuku rĩa athamaki a Juda na Isiraeli.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

kikuyu: Manase nĩaakire igongona thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova, o ĩrĩa Jehova oigĩte ũhoro wayo atĩrĩ, “Rĩĩtwa rĩakwa rĩgaatũũra Jerusalemu nginya tene.”
english: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”

kikuyu: Nĩooire mũhianano mũicũhie ũrĩa aathondekete na akĩũiga thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Ngai, ĩrĩa Ngai eerĩte Daudi na mũriũ Solomoni ũhoro wayo atĩrĩ, “Thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ĩno na thĩinĩ wa Jerusalemu, o kũrĩa ndĩthuurĩire kuuma mĩhĩrĩga-inĩ yothe ya Isiraeli, nĩkuo ngũtũũria Rĩĩtwa rĩakwa nginya tene.
english: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

kikuyu: Jehova akĩarĩria Manase na andũ ake, no matiigana kũmũigua.
english: Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn’t listen.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo aarĩ mũhinyĩrĩrĩku ngoro-rĩ, akĩrongooria ũtugi wa Jehova Ngai wake, na akĩĩnyiihia mũno mbere ya Ngai wa maithe mao.
english: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa mangĩ makoniĩ wathani wa Manase, o hamwe na ũrĩa aahooire Ngai wake, o na ciugo iria ooni-maũndũ maamwarĩirie thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova, Ngai wa Isiraeli-rĩ, nĩmandĩke maandĩko-inĩ ma mahinda ma athamaki a Isiraeli.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: akĩmomora igongona na itugĩ cia Ashera, nayo mĩhianano akĩmĩhehenjithia ĩgĩtuĩka mũtutu, na agĩtinangia igongona cia ũbumba ciothe iria ciarĩ Isiraeli guothe igĩtuĩka icunjĩ. Agĩcooka Jerusalemu.
english: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki akĩrũgama gĩtugĩ-inĩ gĩake na akĩerũhia kĩrĩkanĩro arĩ mbere ya Jehova, atĩ nĩarĩrũmagĩrĩra Jehova na arũmie maathani make, na mawatho make, o na kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo na ngoro yake yothe na muoyo wake wothe, na aathĩkagĩre ciugo cia kĩrĩkanĩro iria ciandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩu.
english: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

kikuyu: Akĩĩra Alawii arĩa maarutanaga Isiraeli guothe na maarĩkĩtie kwamũrĩrwo Jehova atĩrĩ: “Igai ithandũkũ rĩrĩa rĩamũre hekarũ-inĩ ĩrĩa yaakirwo nĩ Solomoni mũrũ wa Daudi mũthamaki wa Isiraeli. Mũtirĩrĩkuuaga na ciande. Na rĩrĩ, tungatagĩrai Jehova Ngai wanyu, na andũ ake a Isiraeli.
english: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to Yahweh, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.

kikuyu: Naguo ũtungata ũgĩtabarĩrio, nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai makĩrũgama handũ hao hamwe na Alawii marĩ ikundi-inĩ ciao o ta ũrĩa mũthamaki aathanĩte.
english: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa mangĩ makoniĩ wathani wa Jehoiakimu, na maũndũ ma magigi marĩa eekire, na maũndũ marĩa mothe oonirwo ahĩtĩtie-rĩ, maandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa athamaki a Isiraeli na a Juda. Nake mũriũ Jehoiakini agĩthamaka ithenya rĩake.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: No-o makĩnyũrũria andũ acio maatũmĩtwo nĩ Ngai, makĩmenereria ciugo ciake, na makĩnyarara anabii ake, o nginya marakara ma Jehova makĩarahũkĩra andũ ake na gũkĩaga kĩhonia.
english: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.

kikuyu: Mwaka wa mbere wa Kurusu mũthamaki wa Perisia, nĩguo kiugo kĩa Jehova kĩrĩa kĩarĩtio nĩ Jeremia kĩhiinge-rĩ, Jehova akĩarahũra ngoro ya Kurusu mũthamaki wa Perisia aanĩrĩrithie kũrĩa guothe aathamakaga, na andĩke atĩrĩ:
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

kikuyu: na nowe ũtũheete ũhoro wa ũrĩa mwendaine mũrĩ thĩinĩ wa Roho.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, o ta ũrĩa mwamũkĩrire Kristũ Jesũ arĩ Mwathani, thiĩi na mbere gũtũũra thĩinĩ wake,
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

kikuyu: O na inyuĩ nĩmwaruire thĩinĩ wake, na ti na ũndũ wa moko ma andũ, no nĩ ũndũ wa kwehererio mũtũũrĩre wa mehia, kũringana na irua rĩrĩa rĩruithanagio nĩ Kristũ.
english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

kikuyu: O na inyuĩ mwatũire mũthiiaga na mĩthiĩre ĩyo mũtũũrĩre-inĩ ũrĩa mwatũũraga mbere ĩyo.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

kikuyu: na mũkehumba mũndũ ũngĩ mwerũ, ũrĩa werũhagio nginya agĩe na ũmenyo na agĩe na mũhianĩre wa ũrĩa wamũũmbire.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

kikuyu: O na inyuĩ ciana-rĩ, athĩkagĩrai aciari anyu maũndũ-inĩ mothe, nĩgũkorwo gwĩka ũguo nĩgũke- nagia Mwathani.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, inyuĩ ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ndamũthaitha thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani witũ Jesũ Kristũ, atĩ inyuothe mũiguane o mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ, nĩguo mũtikagĩe na nyamũkano gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu, no mũikare mũiguanĩte, na mũrĩ na meciiria o mamwe, na ngoro o ĩmwe.
english: Now I beg you, brothers,‡ through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũrimũ wa Ngai nĩ mũũgĩ gũkĩra ũũgĩ wa mũndũ, naguo ũhũthũ wa Ngai nĩ mũritũ gũkĩra hinya wa mũndũ.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

kikuyu: Agĩthuura maũndũ marĩa mahũthũ ma thĩ ĩno, na marĩa matarĩ ma gũtĩĩka, o gwata marĩa matarĩ maũndũ kũrĩ, nĩgeetha amaagithie bata,
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũtarĩ na Roho ndetĩkagĩra maũndũ marĩa moimaga kũrĩ Roho wa Ngai, tondũ maũndũ macio nĩ ũrimũ kũrĩ we, na ndangĩmamenya, tondũ makũũrĩkanaga na njĩra ya kĩĩroho.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

kikuyu: Kaĩ Apolo akĩrĩ ũ? Nake Paũlũ akĩrĩ ũ? Acio maarĩ o ndungata, iria ciatũmire mwĩtĩkie, o ta ũrĩa Mwathani aagaĩire o mũndũ wĩra wake.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ndakae kwĩraha na ũhoro wa andũ! Maũndũ mothe nĩ manyu,
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

kikuyu: Ndingĩmaka o na hanini ingĩtuĩrwo ciira nĩ inyuĩ, kana nduĩrwo nĩ igooti rĩa andũ o na rĩrĩkũ; ti-itherũ o na niĩ mwene ndingĩĩtuĩra ciira.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ndĩrona atĩ ithuĩ atũmwo Ngai atũigĩte handũ tũrĩonekaga tũrĩ thuutha wa andũ arĩa angĩ othe, na ta andũ matuĩrĩirwo kũũragĩrwo thĩinĩ wa kĩhaaro kĩa mathako. Nĩtũtuĩtwo kĩndũ gĩa kwĩrorerwo nĩ thĩ yothe, kũrĩ araika o na kũrĩ andũ.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

kikuyu: o na rĩrĩa twacambio, tũcookagia ũhoro na ũhooreri. Nginya ihinda rĩĩrĩ tũtuĩkĩte gĩko gĩa thĩ, tũgatuĩka mahuti ma gũkũ thĩ.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mũrĩkorwo mũnganĩte thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani witũ Jesũ, na niĩ ndĩ hamwe na inyuĩ thĩinĩ wa roho, o na hinya wa Mwathani witũ Jesũ ũrĩ ho-rĩ,
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: mũndũ ũcio mũneanei kũrĩ Shaitani, nĩgeetha mehia make ma kĩĩmwĩrĩ maniinwo, naguo roho wake ũkaahonokio mũthenya ũrĩa wa Mwathani.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Mwĩgaatho ũcio wanyu ti mwega. Kaĩ inyuĩ mũtooĩ atĩ ndawa nini ya kũimbia mĩgate nĩĩtũmaga kĩmere gĩothe kĩimbe?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

kikuyu: Kaĩ inyuĩ mũtooĩ atĩ andũ arĩa aaganu matikagaya ũthamaki wa Ngai? Mũtikanaheeneke: Gũtirĩ ahũũri maraya, kana ahooi mĩhianano, kana itharia, kana arũme arĩa metuaga ta aka, kana arũme arĩa makomaga na arũme arĩa angĩ,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ũhoro wa irio iria ikoragwo irutĩirwo mĩhianano-rĩ, nĩtũũĩ atĩ ithuothe tũrĩ na ũmenyo ũhoro-inĩ ũcio. Ũmenyo nĩũtũmaga mũndũ etũũgĩrie, no wendo nĩ gwaka wakaga.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

kikuyu: no harĩ ithuĩ-rĩ, Ngai no ũmwe, na nĩwe Ithe witũ, na indo ciothe cioimire kũrĩ we na tũtũũraga muoyo nĩ ũndũ wake; na kũrĩ na Mwathani o ũmwe, nake nĩwe Jesũ Kristũ, o we ũrĩa indo ciothe ciagĩire nĩ ũndũ wake, na nowe ũtũtũũragia muoyo.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mwehĩria ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ na njĩra ĩyo, na mũgatiihia thamiri ciao icio itarĩ hinya-rĩ, nĩ Kristũ mwehĩria.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, angĩkorwo kĩrĩa ndĩrarĩa no gĩtũme mũrũ kana mwarĩ wa Ithe witũ agwe mehia-inĩ-rĩ, ndikĩagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũrĩa nyama rĩngĩ, nĩguo ndigatũme agwe.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

kikuyu: O ta ũguo-rĩ, Mwathani nĩathanĩte atĩ arĩa mahunjagia Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega nĩmagĩrĩirwo kuonaga gĩa kũmatũũria kuuma kũrĩ Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

kikuyu: Othe nĩmabatithirio matuĩke andũ a Musa marĩ rungu rwa itu rĩu, o na marĩ iria-inĩ rĩu.
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, maũndũ macio meekĩkire marĩ ta cionereria, nĩgeetha ngoro ciitũ itikerirĩrie gwĩka maũndũ mooru ta macio meekire.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

kikuyu: Mũtigatuĩke ahooi mĩhianano, ta ũrĩa amwe ao maatariĩ; o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “Andũ acio magĩikara thĩ kũrĩa na kũnyua, magĩcooka magĩũkĩra kũina na gwĩkenia.”
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”*

kikuyu: Nĩngũmũgaathĩrĩria nĩ ũndũ wa kũndirikana maũndũ-inĩ mothe, na nĩ ũndũ wa gũtũũra mũrũmĩtie morutani macio, o ta ũrĩa ndaamũrutire.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũrũme o wothe ũrĩa ũhooyaga kana akaratha ehumbĩrĩte mũtwe-rĩ, nĩ mũtwe wake aconorithagia.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

kikuyu: Nake mũndũ-wa-nja o wothe ũrĩa ũhooyaga kana akaratha atahumbĩrĩte mũtwe wake-rĩ, nĩ mũtwe wake aconorithagia, tondũ ũguo no ũndũ ũmwe na kwenjwo.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

kikuyu: Kaĩ maũndũ ma ndũire matamũrutaga atĩ mũndũ-mũrũme gũkorwo arĩ na njuĩrĩ ndaaya nĩ ũndũ wa kũmũconorithia,
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

kikuyu: no mũndũ-wa-nja gũkorwo na njuĩrĩ ndaaya, ũcio nĩ riiri wake? Nĩgũkorwo aheetwo njuĩrĩ ndaaya arĩ kĩndũ gĩa kũmũhumbĩra.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

kikuyu: nake ũngĩ akaheo wĩtĩkio nĩ Roho o ro ũcio, na ũngĩ akaheo iheo cia kũhonania nĩ Roho o ro ũcio,
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

kikuyu: Maũndũ macio mothe nĩ wĩra wa Roho o ro ũcio ũmwe, nake agayagĩra o mũndũ o ũrĩa ekwenda.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

kikuyu: Mwĩrĩ wothe ũngĩkorwo no riitho-rĩ, kũigua tũngĩiguaga na kĩ? Mwĩrĩ wothe ũngĩkorwo no gũtũ-rĩ, kũnungĩra tũngĩnungagĩra na kĩ?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

kikuyu: No ũrĩa kũrĩ, nĩ atĩ Ngai nĩ eekĩrire ciĩga ciothe thĩinĩ wa mwĩrĩ, agĩciĩkĩra o ta ũrĩa eendaga ciikare.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

kikuyu: Ciĩga ciothe ingĩtuĩka nĩ kĩĩga kĩmwe-rĩ, mwĩrĩ naguo ũngĩkorwo ha?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

kikuyu: Andũ othe nĩmaheetwo iheo cia kũhonania? Andũ othe nĩmakĩaragia na thiomi? Andũ othe nĩmagĩtaũraga thiomi?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

kikuyu: Wendani nĩũkiranagĩrĩria, na wendani nĩũtuganaga. Ndũiguanagĩra ũiru, na ndwĩgaathaga, o na ndũrĩ mwĩtĩĩo.
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

kikuyu: Wendani ndũrĩ rũtũrĩko, na ndũcaragia ũrĩa ũngĩĩguna, o na ndũhiũhaga kũrakara, na ndũtaraga maita marĩa ũhĩtĩirio.
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

kikuyu: Rĩu tuonaga maũndũ na mairia, ta kuona na gĩcicio; no hĩndĩ ĩyo tũkoonaga ta andũ makĩonana ũthiũ kwa ũthiũ. Rĩu njũũĩ maũndũ o gĩcunjĩ; hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngamenya maũndũ wega, o ta ũrĩa niĩ njũũĩo wega.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

kikuyu: No ũkorwo ũgĩcookia ngaatho wega mũno, no mũndũ ũcio ũngĩ ndanongererwo hinya nĩ ũhoro ũcio.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

kikuyu: Aheani ũhoro eerĩ kana atatũ magĩrĩirwo maarie, nao andũ arĩa angĩ makũũrane wega ũrĩa kũreerwo.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

kikuyu: Hĩ! Anga kiugo kĩa Ngai kĩambĩrĩirie na inyuĩ? Kana hihi no inyuĩ inyuiki gĩakinyĩire?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũhoro ũrĩa niĩ ndaamũkĩrire nĩguo ndaamũheire, ũrĩ wa mbere na wa bata mũno: atĩ Kristũ nĩakuire nĩ ũndũ wa mehia maitũ o ta ũrĩa Maandĩko moigĩte,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: na thuutha wa acio angĩ othe akĩnyumĩrĩra o na niĩ, haana ta mũndũ waciarĩtwo atarĩ mũkinyu.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio, o na kũngĩtuĩka nĩ niĩ kana nĩ o-rĩ, ũhoro ũyũ noguo tũhunjagia, na noguo inyuĩ mwetĩkirie.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo ndaahũũranire na nyamũ cia gĩthaka kũu Efeso nĩ ũndũ wa itũmi cia ũ- mũndũ-rĩ, ndaagunĩkire na kĩ? Angĩkorwo andũ arĩa akuũ matikaariũkio-rĩ, “Nĩtũrĩe na tũnyue, nĩgũkorwo rũciũ nĩgũkua tũgaakua.”
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”*

kikuyu: Arahũkai mwĩigue ta ũrĩa mwagĩrĩirwo, na mũtigage kwĩhia; nĩgũkorwo andũ amwe matiũĩ Ngai: ndoiga ũguo nĩgeetha ndĩmũconore.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Ngai arogaathwo nĩgũkorwo nĩwe ũtũheaga ũtooria thĩinĩ wa Mwathani witũ Jesũ Kristũ.
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Na kũngĩkoneka kwagĩrĩire o na niĩ thiĩ-rĩ, nĩngatwarana nao.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

kikuyu: tondũ ndĩmũhingũrĩre mweke mũnene wa kũruta wĩra mwega ũrĩ na uumithio, no nacio thũ nĩ nyingĩ.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ha ũhoro ũkoniĩ mũrũ wa Ithe witũ Apolo-rĩ: nĩndamũringĩrĩirie mũno ooke kũrĩ inyuĩ arĩ hamwe na ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ. Nowe ndeendaga gũũka ihinda rĩu, no nĩarĩũka aagĩa na mweke.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

kikuyu: mwathĩkagĩre andũ ta acio, na mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa ũrutithanagia wĩra na ithuĩ, akĩũnogagĩra.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

kikuyu: Niĩ, Paũlũ, nĩ niĩ ndandĩka ngeithi ici na guoko gwakwa.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

kikuyu: Ndabangĩte ndĩmũceerere ngĩthiĩ Makedonia, na njokere kũu kwanyu ngiuma Makedonia, na inyuĩ nĩguo mũcooke mũndũme Judea.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

kikuyu: Rĩu inyuĩ-rĩ, nĩmwagĩrĩirwo nĩkũmũrekera na kũmũũmĩrĩria, nĩguo ndakae gũtoorio nĩ kĩeha gĩkĩrĩte.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

kikuyu: Ũcio nĩguo ũũmĩrĩru witũ harĩ Ngai nĩ ũndũ wa Kristũ.
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa rĩothe mũndũ o na ũ agarũrũkĩra Mwathani- rĩ, gĩtambaya kĩu nĩkĩeheragio.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio, kuona atĩ nĩ tũrĩ na ũtungata ũcio nĩ ũndũ wa tha cia Ngai-rĩ, tũtiũragwo nĩ hinya.
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
