english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo mũmaraya atũmaga mũndũ athĩĩne nginya ahooyage kenyũ ka mũgate, na mũtumia mũtharia aguĩmaga muoyo waku guo mwene.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

kikuyu: Nguraro na kwĩnyararithia nĩcio igai rĩake, na cio thoni icio ciake gũtirĩ hĩndĩ igaathario ithire;
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

kikuyu: Aikũrũkaga na njĩra ĩrĩa yarĩ hakuhĩ na koine ya kwa mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio, agĩthiĩ na njĩra ĩyo yerekeire na gwake mũciĩ,
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndoimagara, ndooka gũgũtũnga; ngũgũcarĩtie mũno, na rĩu nĩndakuona!
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

kikuyu: Githĩ ũũgĩ ndareetana? Githĩ ũtaũku ndaranĩrĩra na mũgambo wake?
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

kikuyu: Kanua gakwa kaaragia ũhoro wa ma, nĩgũkorwo mĩromo yakwa nĩĩthũire waganu mũno ta kĩndũ kĩrĩ magigi.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩra na ũũgĩ wa gũkũũrana maũndũ nĩ ciakwa; niĩ ndĩ na ũtaũku, na ndĩ na ũhoti.
english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

kikuyu: “Jehova aanyũmbire o kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kĩa wĩra wake, mbere ya mawĩra make ma tene;
english: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

kikuyu: we atanoomba thĩ kana ithaka ciayo, o na kana rũkũngũ o ruothe rwa thĩ.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ ariũ akwa, ta thikĩrĩriai; kũrathimwo nĩ arĩa marũmagia njĩra ciakwa.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

kikuyu: Ta thikĩrĩriai mataaro makwa nĩguo mũhĩge; mũtikamarege.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

kikuyu: Kũrathimwo nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũnjiguaga, agacũthagĩrĩria mĩrango-inĩ yakwa o mũthenya, akanjetagĩrĩra hingĩro-inĩ cia mĩrango yakwa.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

kikuyu: Nĩahaarĩirie nyama, na akahaarĩria ndibei,* o na akaara metha yake.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

kikuyu: “Maaĩ ma kũiya marĩ mũrĩo; o na irio iria irĩĩagĩrwo hitho-inĩ irĩ cama!”
english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

kikuyu: Ũrĩa ũcookanagĩrĩria irio hĩndĩ ya riũa nĩ mwana mũũgĩ, no ũrĩa ũkomaga hĩndĩ ya magetha nĩ mwana wa kũrehe thoni.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

kikuyu: Andũ oogĩ meigagĩra ũmenyo, no kanua ga kĩrimũ keĩtagĩria mwanangĩko.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

kikuyu: Ratiri itarĩ cia ma nĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩ magigi harĩ Jehova, no nĩakenagĩra mahiga ma gũthima marĩa maigananu.
english: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ arĩa athingu magaacĩra, itũũra nĩgũkena rĩkenaga; rĩrĩa andũ arĩa aaganu maathira, nĩkũrũhio kũrũũhagio.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa mũthingu kũna nĩagatũũra muoyo, no mũndũ ũrĩa ũrũmagĩrĩra waganu nĩ gũkua agaakua.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ mũndũ mwaganu ndakaaga kũherithio, no andũ arĩa athingu nĩmakahonokio.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring† of the righteous will be delivered.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa mwega nĩatugagwo nĩ Jehova, no mũndũ mwara Jehova amũtuaga mũndũ mwĩhia.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

kikuyu: Mũndũ agaathagĩrĩrio kũringana na ũũgĩ wake, no andũ marĩ meciiria mogomu nĩmamenagwo.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ ũũru ũngĩkora andũ arĩa athingu, no arĩa aaganu maiyũrĩtwo nĩ thĩĩna.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũbaarĩrĩri nĩahithaga ũmenyi wake, no ngoro cia andũ arĩa akĩĩgu ĩmemerekagia ũrimũ.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

kikuyu: Muoyo wonekaga na njĩra ya ũthingu; na njĩra-inĩ ĩyo-rĩ, kũrĩ muoyo ũtagaathira.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũthũire ũrutani nĩeyũnũhaga, no ũrĩa ũtĩĩaga maathani nĩakaheo kĩheo.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũregaga gũtaarwo anyiitagwo nĩ thĩĩna na thoni, no mũndũ ũrĩa wĩtĩkagĩra gũkaanio atuĩkaga wa gũtĩĩo.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

kikuyu: Kũrĩ njĩra mũndũ onaga ta yagĩrĩire, no marigĩrĩrio mayo yerekagĩria mũndũ o gĩkuũ-inĩ.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũtarĩ ũũgĩ etĩkagia ũndũ o wothe, no mũndũ mũbaarĩrĩri nĩacũũranagia ũhoro wa makinya make.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũmenaga mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake nĩ kwĩhia ehagia, no kũrathimwo nĩ ũrĩa ũiguagĩra athĩĩni tha.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

kikuyu: Ngoro ĩrĩ na thayũ ĩheaga mwĩrĩ muoyo, no ũiru ũbuthagia mahĩndĩ.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

kikuyu: Ũũgĩ nĩ ũikaraga ngoro-inĩ ya ũrĩa ũũĩ gũkũũrana maũndũ, o na gatagatĩ ka irimũ nĩwĩmenyithanagia.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki nĩakenagio nĩ ndungata njũgĩ, no nĩangʼũrĩkagio nĩ ndungata ĩrĩa ĩmũconorithagia.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

kikuyu: Njĩra cia andũ arĩa aaganu nĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩ magigi harĩ Jehova, no nĩendete andũ arĩa mathingataga ũthingu.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

kikuyu: Harĩ mũndũ ũrĩa mũũgĩ njĩra ya muoyo ĩrorete na igũrũ, ĩmũgirie gũikũrũka mbĩrĩra-inĩ.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.‡

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũkoroku arehagĩra nyũmba yake thĩĩna, no ũrĩa ũthũire mahaki nĩagatũũra muoyo.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

kikuyu: Kaba indo nini cionekete na njĩra ya ũthingu, gũkĩra uumithio mũnene ũtarĩ wa kĩhooto.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

kikuyu: Mũndũ wa haaro aheenagĩrĩria mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake, akamũtongoria njĩra-inĩ ĩtarĩ njega.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

kikuyu: Nĩ kaba mũndũ mũkirĩrĩria gũkĩra njamba ya ita, na nĩ kaba mũndũ ũrĩa ũrigagĩrĩria marakara make gũkĩra ũrĩa wĩnyiitagĩra itũũra inene.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

kikuyu: Nĩ kaba kĩenyũ kĩũmũ kĩa mũgate kũndũ kũrĩ na thayũ na ũhooreri, gũkĩra nyũmba ĩiyũrĩte ndĩa no ĩrĩ na ngũĩ.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mwaganu athikagĩrĩria mĩromo ĩrĩa yaragia waganu; nake mũndũ wa maheeni athikagĩrĩria rũrĩmĩ rũrĩa rwaragia maũndũ ma gũthũkia.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

kikuyu: Nĩ kaba gũcemania na nduba ĩtunyĩtwo ciana ciayo gũkĩra gũcemania na mũndũ mũkĩĩgu na ũrimũ wake.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

kikuyu: Kwambĩrĩria haaro nĩ ta kũhingũrĩra maaĩ mahingĩrĩrie; nĩ ũndũ ũcio tiganaga na ũhoro ũcio ngarari itaanagĩa.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

kikuyu: Mwana mũkĩĩgu arehagĩra ithe kĩeha, na marũrũ kũrĩ nyina ũrĩa wamũciarire.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

kikuyu: Ti wega kũgĩa na kĩyo hatarĩ na ũmenyo, ningĩ kũhĩkĩka mũno gũtũmaga mũndũ ahĩtie njĩra.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo mũndũ mũthĩĩni nĩatiganagio nĩ andũ ao othe-rĩ, ĩ nao arata ake mangĩkĩmwĩtheema atĩa! O na angĩmathingata akĩmathaithaga, nĩmethiĩrĩire, matirĩ ho.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

kikuyu: Mĩbango ya ngoro ya mũndũ nĩ mĩingĩ, no muoroto wa Jehova noguo ũkaahinga.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

kikuyu: Mahiga ma ratiri mataiganainie ũritũ, o na ithimi itaiganĩte: cierĩ nĩ indo irĩ magigi harĩ Jehova.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Thahabu nĩ kũrĩ, o na ruru no nyingĩ, no mĩromo ĩrĩa yaragia ũmenyo nĩ ithaga rĩa goro rĩrĩa rĩtonekaga.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

kikuyu: Igai rĩrĩa rĩoneka narua kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ, marigĩrĩrio-inĩ rĩtituĩkaga rĩa kĩrathimo.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

kikuyu: Mahũũra na nguraro nĩitheragia ũũru wa mũndũ, nacio iboko itheragia o nginya tũturi twa thĩinĩ mũno.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũmenyagĩrĩra kanua gake na rũrĩmĩ rwake nĩeyeheragia mũtino-inĩ.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

kikuyu: Mũira wa maheeni nĩgũthira agaathira, nake ũrĩa ũmũthikagĩrĩria akaanangwo nginya tene.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa atongu nĩ mathaga arĩa athĩĩni, na ũrĩa ũkombaga nĩ ndungata ya mũmũkoomberi.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

kikuyu: Nĩwonaga mũndũ mũũgĩ na wĩra wake? Ũcio agatungata o na mbere ya athamaki; ndagatungata mbere ya andũ matooĩkaine.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

kikuyu: Mũhũũrage na rũthanju nĩguo ũhonokie muoyo wake kuuma kũrĩ gĩkuũ.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.†

kikuyu: Nũũ ũrĩ na haaro? Nũũ ũrĩ na kĩeha? Nũũ ũrĩ hatĩka-inĩ? Nũũ ũrĩ na mateta? Nũũ ũgurarĩtio hatarĩ gĩtũmi? Nũũ ũtunĩhĩtie maitho?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

kikuyu: Tiga kwĩrorera ndibei rĩrĩa ĩtunĩhĩte, rĩrĩa ĩgũkenga ĩrĩ gĩkombe-inĩ, rĩrĩa ĩkũmerũka wega!
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũthugundaga ũũru-rĩ, andũ mamwĩtaga mungumania.
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

kikuyu: Ũngĩtuĩka wa kũũrwo nĩ hinya hĩndĩ ya thĩĩna, hinya waku kaĩ nĩ mũnini-ĩ!
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

kikuyu: Ici nĩ thimo ingĩ cia Solomoni, iria ciacookanĩrĩirio na ikĩandĩkwo nĩ andũ a Hezekia ũrĩa warĩ mũthamaki wa Juda:
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

kikuyu: O ta gĩthima kĩiyũrĩte ndaka, kana itherũkĩro rĩa maaĩ riunjuge, ũguo nĩguo mũndũ mũthingu ahaanaga angĩĩrekereria harĩ andũ arĩa aaganu.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

kikuyu: Wanona mũndũ wĩonaga arĩ mũũgĩ maitho-inĩ make? Mũndũ mũkĩĩgu arĩ na kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro gũkĩra mũndũ ũcio.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Kĩgũũta kiugaga atĩrĩ, “Njĩra-inĩ kũrĩ na mũrũũthi, mũrũũthi mũrĩĩani ũrorũũra njĩra-inĩ cia itũũra!”
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

kikuyu: Kĩgũũta kĩĩonaga kĩrĩ kĩũgĩ maitho-inĩ makĩo, gũkĩra andũ mũgwanja arĩa macookagia ũhoro na ũũgĩ.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

kikuyu: Mwĩhĩtũkĩri wĩtoonyagia inegene-inĩ rĩtamũkoniĩ no ta mũndũ ũkũnyiita ngui matũ.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa makara magwatagia marĩa mangĩ mwaki, na o ta ũrĩa ngũ ciakanagia mwaki, noguo mũndũ mũũgiti aakagĩrĩria haaro.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

kikuyu: Rũrĩmĩ rwa maheeni nĩkũmena rũmenete arĩa rũtuuragia, nako kanua ga kwĩyendithĩrĩria karehaga mwanangĩko.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

kikuyu: O na ũngĩhũũrĩra mũndũ mũkĩĩgu ndĩrĩ-inĩ, ũmũhũũre na mũũthĩ ta ngano-rĩ, ndangiumwo nĩ ũrimũ wake.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

kikuyu: Nyeki ĩrĩa nyũmũ rĩrĩa yatũgũtwo na nyeki njerũ ĩkunũke-rĩ, nayo ĩrĩa ya irĩma-inĩ yũnganio na ĩinũkio-rĩ,
english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

kikuyu: Nĩ kaba mũndũ mũthĩĩni ũrĩa ũthiiaga na mĩthiĩre ĩtarĩ ũcuuke, gũkĩra gĩtonga gĩthiiaga na mĩthiĩre mĩogomu.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũtongu no eyone taarĩ mũũgĩ maitho-inĩ make, no mũndũ mũthĩĩni ũrĩa ũũĩ gũkũũrana maũndũ amuonaga o ũrĩa atariĩ.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mwaganu agĩatha andũ matarĩ na ũhoti, nĩ ta mũrũũthi ũkũrarama, kana nduba ĩgũticũka.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũtunyaga ithe kana nyina kĩndũ kĩao, agacooka akoiga atĩrĩ, “Ti ũũru ndeka,” ũcio marĩ rũmwe na ũrĩa wanangaga.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa athingu nĩmamenyagĩrĩra kĩhooto kĩa arĩa athĩĩni, no arĩa aaganu matirũmbũyagia kĩhooto kĩao.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

kikuyu: “Nĩngũkũhooya maũndũ meerĩ, Wee Jehova; ndũkanarege kũhe mo mbere ya ngue:
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

kikuyu: nĩo arĩa magego mao mahaana ta hiũ cia njora, na ngambucu ciao ihaana ta tũhiũ twa gũtambuura arĩa athĩĩni, mahuke thĩ, na arĩa abatari, mathire andũ-inĩ.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

kikuyu: namo nĩ mũthiĩre wa nderi rĩera-inĩ, na mũthiĩre wa nyoka rwaro-inĩ rwa ihiga, na mũthiĩre wa marikabu ĩrĩ iria-inĩ gatagatĩ, na mũthiĩre wa mũndũ makĩendana na mũirĩtu.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

kikuyu: “Kũrĩ indo ithatũ irĩ mũkinyũkĩrie mũgaacĩru, o na nĩ inya ngaacĩru rĩrĩa igũthiĩ:
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

kikuyu: reke manyue mariganĩrwo nĩ ũthĩĩni wao, na matige gũcooka kũririkana kĩeha kĩao.
english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

kikuyu: Ethaga guoya wa ngʼondu na ndigi cia ũguta, agacirutĩra wĩra na kĩyo, na moko make.
english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

kikuyu: Ahaana ta marikabu cia wonjoria, tondũ athũgũraga irio ciake kuuma kũraya.
english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

kikuyu: Anyiitaga mũtĩ wa kuogotha ndigi na guoko, nakĩo gĩcũni kĩa ndigi agakĩnyiitĩrĩra na ciara ciake.
english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

kikuyu: Nĩataanahagĩra andũ arĩa athĩĩni, nao arĩa abatari akamatambũrũkĩria moko make.
english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

kikuyu: Nĩatumaga indo cia kwara ũrĩrĩ wake; nake ehumbaga nguo cia gatani ĩrĩa njega, na cia rangi wa ndathi.†
english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

kikuyu: Hinya na ũtĩĩku nĩcio nguo iria ehumbaga; nĩakenaga ategwĩtigĩra matukũ marĩa magooka.
english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩ watho wa Jehova akenagĩra, na agecũũranagia ũhoro wa watho wake kũrĩ mũthenya kana ũtukũ.
english: but his delight is in Yahweh’s† law. On his law he meditates day and night.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, matue nĩmahĩtĩtie! Reke magũithio nĩ mĩbango ĩyo yao ya ungumania. Maingate nĩ ũndũ wa mehia mao maingĩ, nĩgũkorwo nĩmakũremeire.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, reke arĩa moragĩra harĩwe makene; nĩmarekwo mainage hĩndĩ ciothe nĩ gũkena. Tambũrũkia ũgitĩri waku igũrũ rĩao, nĩguo arĩa mendete rĩĩtwa rĩaku magũkenagĩre.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩaiguĩte ngĩmũthaitha anjiguĩre tha; Jehova nĩetĩkĩrĩte ihooya rĩakwa.
english: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

kikuyu: Ngai-Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno nĩwe ngo yakwa, ũrĩa ũhonokagia arĩa arũngĩrĩru ngoro.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Jehova athamakaga nginya tene; nĩahaandĩte gĩtĩ gĩake kĩa ũnene nĩguo atuanĩre ciira.
english: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

kikuyu: Nĩagatuĩra andũ a thĩ ciira na kĩhooto; nĩagathamakĩra ndũrĩrĩ o ta ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

kikuyu: nĩguo nyumbũre ũgooci waku ndĩ kũu ihingo-inĩ cia Mwarĩ wa Zayuni, na ndĩ kũu ngenagĩre ũhonokio waku.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Ndũrĩrĩ nĩigwĩte o irima rĩrĩa cienjete; magũrũ maacio nĩmanyiitĩtwo nĩ wabu o ũcio ihithĩte wa gũtegana.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩemenyithanĩtie na ũndũ wa gũtuanĩra ciira na kĩhooto gĩake; andũ arĩa aaganu nĩmetegete na wĩra wa moko mao ene.
english: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

kikuyu: ũgitagĩra andũ arĩa matarĩ maithe na arĩa ahinyĩrĩrie, nĩgeetha mũndũ, ũrĩa ũrĩ o wa thĩ, ndagacooke gwĩkanĩra guoya.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

kikuyu: Nacio ciugo cia Jehova itirĩ mahĩtia, ihaana ta betha ĩthereirio kĩrugutĩro-inĩ kĩa rĩũmba, ĩtheretio maita mũgwanja.
english: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

kikuyu: Mĩnyamaro-inĩ yakwa ndakaĩire Jehova; ngĩrĩrĩra Ngai wakwa aandeithie. Arĩ hekarũ-inĩ yake nĩ aaiguire mũgambo wakwa; kĩrĩro gĩakwa gĩgĩkinya harĩ we, o matũ-inĩ make.
english: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

kikuyu: Aathiire akuuĩtwo nĩ ikerubi* akĩũmbũka; akĩambata na igũrũ na mathagu ma rũhuho.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Andeithũrire harĩ thũ yakwa ĩrĩ hinya, akĩndeithũra kũrĩ arĩa maathũire, o acio maangĩrĩtie hinya.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

kikuyu: Manjĩhotoreire mũthenya ũrĩa ndaarĩ na mũtino, no Jehova nĩwe warĩ mũtiirĩrĩri wakwa.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

kikuyu: Andeehire kũndũ kwariĩ; akĩndeithũra nĩ tondũ nĩakenetio nĩ niĩ.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

kikuyu: Mũrungu-rĩ, njĩra ciake nĩnginyanĩru; kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩtirĩ ihĩtia. We nĩwe ngo ya arĩa othe mehithaga harĩ we.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Igũrũ riumbũraga riiri wa Mũrungu; namo matu mamemerekagia wĩra wa moko make.
english: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

kikuyu: Ningĩ rigagĩrĩria ndungata yaku ndĩkeehie mehia ma mwĩĩro o namo; ndũkanareke mehia macio manjathe. Nĩguo ndĩrĩikaraga itarĩ na ũcuuke, na itarĩ na mehia ma kwagarara watho.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

kikuyu: Ciugo cia kanua gakwa na matarania ma ngoro yakwa irogũkenia maitho-inĩ maku, Wee Jehova, o Wee Rwaro rwakwa rwa Ihiga, na Mũkũũri wakwa.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

kikuyu: Aroririkana magongona maku mothe, na etĩkĩre maruta maku ma njino.
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

kikuyu: Makurumaga makagũa thĩ, no ithuĩ tũrũgamaga tũkehaanda.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

kikuyu: Nĩũmũhingĩirie wendi wa ngoro yake, naguo ũndũ ũrĩa akũhooete na mĩromo yake ndũmũimĩte.
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Riiri wake nĩ mũnene nĩ ũndũ wa ũhootani ũrĩa ũmũheete; nĩũmũheete riiri na igweta.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai wakwa, ngũkayagĩra mũthenya, no ndũnjĩtĩkaga, ngũkayagĩra ũtukũ, na ndingĩkira.
english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

kikuyu: No niĩ nduĩkĩte o ta kĩgunyũ, no ti ta mũndũ, nganyararwo nĩ andũ na ngamenwo nĩ kĩrĩndĩ.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩwe mũrĩithi wakwa, ndirĩ kĩndũ ingĩaga.
english: Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo nĩwe waakire mũthingi wayo igũrũ rĩa maria, na akĩmĩrũmia ĩikare igũrũ rĩa maaĩ.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

kikuyu: Nũũ ũngĩambata kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Jehova? Nũũ ũngĩrũgama handũ harĩa hake haamũre?
english: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

kikuyu: Ũguo nĩguo rũciaro rwa arĩa mamũrongoragia rũtariĩ, o rũrĩa rũrongoragia ũthiũ waku, Wee Ngai wa Jakubu.
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, ngoro yakwa ndĩmĩroretie na igũrũ kũrĩ we;
english: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Wĩkindĩru wa ngoro na ũrũngĩrĩru irongitagĩra, tondũ nĩwe njĩrĩgagĩrĩra.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

kikuyu: Mũgambo wa Jehova ũinainagia werũ; Jehova ainainagia Werũ wa Kadeshi.
english: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

kikuyu: Inĩrai Jehova mũmũgooce, inyuĩ andũ ake aamũre; mũgooce rĩĩtwa rĩu rĩake itheru,
english: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, thikĩrĩria na ũnjiguĩre tha; Wee Jehova, tuĩka ũteithio wakwa.”
english: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”

kikuyu: Nĩmariganĩirwo nĩ niĩ o ta mũndũ ũkuĩte; ngakĩhaana o ta nyũngũ nguũ.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, ndũkareke njonorithio, nĩgũkorwo nĩwe ngayagĩra; no andũ arĩa aaganu ũreke maconorithio na makome mbĩrĩra-inĩ makirĩte ki.
english: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.†

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova na kĩnanda kĩa mũgeeto; mũinĩrei na kĩnanda kĩrĩa kĩgeete na nga ikũmi.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo aaririe, thĩ ĩkĩgĩa kuo; aathanire, ĩkĩĩhaanda, ĩkĩrũma wega.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩarigiicaga mĩbango ya ndũrĩrĩ; nĩathũkagia mĩoroto ya andũ.
english: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

kikuyu: Ũkai ciana ciakwa, mũthikĩrĩrie ũrĩa nguuga; nĩngũmũruta gwĩtigĩra Jehova.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

kikuyu: Garũrũka utige gwĩka ũũru na wĩke ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire; caragia thayũ na ũũthingatage.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

kikuyu: Hiũria itimũ na mĩcengi, ũũkĩrĩre arĩa maathingatĩte. Ĩra ngoro yakwa atĩrĩ, “Niĩ nĩ niĩ ũhonokio waku.”
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

kikuyu: Nĩngwanĩrĩra na ngoro yakwa yothe, njũũrie atĩrĩ, “Nũũ ũhaana tawe, Wee Jehova? O Wee ũhatũraga andũ arĩa athĩĩni harĩ arĩa marĩ hinya kũmakĩra, ũkahatũra athĩĩni na abatari harĩ arĩa mamatunyaga indo.”
english: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

kikuyu: Wega wakwa mandĩhaga na ũũru, magatiga ngoro yakwa ĩrĩ na ihooru.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo gĩthima kĩa muoyo kĩrĩ kũrĩ we; ũtheri-inĩ waku nĩho tuonaga ũtheri.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

kikuyu: Hoorera mbere ya Jehova na ũmweterere ũtegũthethũka; ndũgathĩĩnĩke ngoro rĩrĩa andũ magaacĩra mĩthiĩre-inĩ yao, rĩrĩa mekũhingia mathugunda mao ma gwĩka ũũru.
english: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa aaganu macomorete hiũ cia njora, na makageeta ũta nĩguo maniine mũndũ ũrĩa mũthĩĩni na mũbatari, na moorage andũ arĩa njĩra ciao irũngĩrĩirie.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo hinya wa andũ arĩa aaganu nĩũkaniinwo, no Jehova atiiragĩrĩra andũ arĩa athingu.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

kikuyu: Wee Mwathani, wendi wakwa wothe ũrĩ o mbere yaku; gũcaaya gwakwa ti kũhitharu harĩwe.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ndoigire atĩrĩ, “Ndũkanareke thũ ciakwa ingenerere, o na kana ciĩtũũgĩrie igũrũ rĩakwa rĩrĩa kũgũrũ gwakwa gwatenderũka.”
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, ndũkandiganĩrie; Wee Ngai wakwa, ndũgaikare haraihu na niĩ.
english: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Wee-rĩ, ti magongona na maruta weriragĩria, no nĩũũheete matũ ma gũkũigua; maruta ma njino na maruta ma kũhoroheria mehia ti mo maakũbatairie.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

kikuyu: Niĩ ndihithagĩrĩra ũthingu waku ngoro-inĩ yakwa; njaragia ũhoro wa wĩhokeku na ũhonokio waku. Wendo waku na ũhoro waku wa ma ndirĩ ndacihitha kĩũngano kĩrĩa kĩnene.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩarĩmũgitagĩra na amũtũũragie muoyo; nĩarĩmũrathimaga bũrũri-inĩ, na ndakamũrekereria kũrĩ merirĩria ma thũ ciake.
english: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

kikuyu: Thũ ciakwa ciothe iheehanagĩra nĩguo iinjũkĩrĩre; injiiragĩrĩra maũndũ mooru mũno, ikoiga atĩrĩ,
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

kikuyu: Ngoro yakwa nĩ Ngai ĩnyootagĩra, O we Mũrungu ũrĩa ũrĩ muoyo. Ĩ nĩ rĩ ngaathiĩ ngacemanie na Ngai?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

kikuyu: Ndindaga njonokete mũthenya wothe, ngahumbwo nĩ thoni ũthiũ wothe,
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

kikuyu: Ngoro ciitũ iticookete na thuutha; makinya maitũ matiumĩte njĩra-inĩ yaku.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

kikuyu: Wee Mwathani, arahũka! Ũgĩkomete nĩkĩ? Wĩyarahũre! Ndũgatũtiganĩrie nginya tene.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord?† Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

kikuyu: Mwarĩ wa mũthamaki no riiri mũtheri arĩ naguo arĩ thĩinĩ wa nyũmba yake, nguo yake ĩtumĩtwo na ndigi cia thahabu.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

kikuyu: Ciana cianyu nĩcio igaacooka ithenya rĩa maithe manyu; ũkaamatua anene bũrũri-inĩ guothe.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

kikuyu: Ngai nĩwe rĩũrĩro riitũ o na hinya witũ, o we ũteithio witũ hĩndĩ ya mathĩĩna.
english: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩma kĩu kĩa Ngai nĩ gĩthaka na gĩkaraiha na igũrũ, na nĩkĩo gĩkeno gĩa thĩ yothe. O ta ũrĩa Zafoni gũtũgĩrĩte na igũrũ mũno, no taguo Kĩrĩma gĩa Zayuni kĩhaana, itũũra rĩu inene rĩa Mũthamaki ũrĩa Mũnene.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩma gĩa Zayuni nĩgĩkenaga, namo matũũra ma Juda magacanjamũka nĩ ũndũ wa matuĩro maku ma ciira.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

kikuyu: Nĩngũtega gũtũ ndĩĩiguĩre thimo; njooke ndaũre ndaĩ ĩno ngĩhũũraga kĩnanda kĩa mũgeeto:
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

kikuyu: agakua athiĩ kũrĩ maithe mao, acio matagacooka kuona ũtheri rĩngĩ.
english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

kikuyu: Ingĩkorwo hũtiĩ, ndingĩkwĩra, nĩgũkorwo thĩ nĩ yakwa, na kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩrĩ thĩinĩ wayo.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

kikuyu: na ũngayagĩre mũthenya wa mĩnyamaro; na nĩndĩrĩkũhonokagia, nawe ũngoocage.”
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

kikuyu: Rũrĩmĩ rwaku rũthugundaga mwanangĩko; rũhaana ta rwenji rũnoore, o wee wĩkaga maũndũ ma maheeni.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, niĩ ndariĩ ta mũtĩ wa mũtamaiyũ, ũrĩa ũrakũra wega ũrĩ thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya Ngai; ndĩhokete wendo wa Ngai ũrĩa ũtathiraga nginya tene na tene.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

kikuyu: Othe nĩmacookete na thuutha, othe marĩ hamwe nĩmatuĩkĩte amaramari; gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wĩkaga wega, gũtirĩ o na ũmwe.
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: njigua na ũnjĩtĩke. Meciiria makwa nĩmathĩĩnĩtie na ndĩ mũgiĩku
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

kikuyu: Mĩario yake ĩnyorokete o ta thiagĩ, no rĩrĩ, mbaara ĩrĩ ngoro-inĩ yake; ciugo ciake ihooranagĩria gũkĩra maguta, no icio nĩ hiũ cia njora irĩ njomore.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa manjambagia maingatanaga na niĩ mũthenya wothe; aingĩ nĩ arĩa maraatharĩkĩra na mwĩtĩĩo.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

kikuyu: ĩrĩa ĩtangĩigua rwĩmbo rwa mũmĩthuuthĩri, o na angĩkorwo aramĩthuuthĩra arĩ na ũũgĩ mũnene atĩa.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

kikuyu: Gileadi nĩ gwakwa, o na Manase no gwakwa;† Efiraimu nĩ ngũbia yakwa ya kĩgera, na Juda nĩ rũthanju rwakwa rwa ũthamaki.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Ngai arĩ hamwe na ithuĩ nĩtũkũhootana, na nĩakarangĩrĩria thũ ciitũ thĩ.
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

kikuyu: Wee ngoro yakwa, etha ũhurũko harĩ Ngai o we wiki, kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro gĩakwa kĩrĩ harĩ we.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

kikuyu: Nĩnguonete ũrĩ handũ-harĩa-haamũre, na ngeyonera hinya waku na riiri waku.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

kikuyu: o Wee wahooreririe mũrurumo wa maria, ũkĩhooreria mũrurumo wa ndiihũ ciamo, na ũgĩkiria inegene rĩa ndũrĩrĩ.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

kikuyu: Ũiyũragia mĩtaro yakuo maaĩ, na ũkaaragania mĩkũmũkũmũ yakuo; ũmĩororoagia na mbura ya rũthuthuũ, na ũkarathima kĩmera kĩayo.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

kikuyu: Aagarũrire iria rĩgĩtuĩka thĩ nyũmũ, nao andũ makĩhĩtũkĩra kũu maaĩ-inĩ na magũrũ; ũkai, tũmũkenere.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

kikuyu: Andũ marokũgooca, Wee Ngai; andũ othe marogũkumia.
english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Andũ aku magĩtũũra kuo, na kuumana na ũingĩ wa indo ciaku, Wee Ngai-rĩ, ũgĩtanahĩra athĩĩni acio.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

kikuyu: Aini a nyĩmbo nĩo matongoretie, makarũmĩrĩrwo nĩ ahũũri inanda; hamwe nao nĩ airĩtu arĩa marahũũra tũhembe.
english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩngirĩrĩirie kũmenwo nĩ ũndũ waku, naguo ũthiũ wakwa nĩũhumbĩtwo thoni.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ngũrĩra na ngehinga kũrĩa irio, no nginya ngirĩrĩrie kũnyũrũrio;
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, njĩtĩka nĩ ũndũ wa wega wa wendo waku; nĩ ũndũ wa tha ciaku nyingĩ wĩhũgũre ũnjookerere.
english: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

kikuyu: Mathitangĩre o ngero thuutha wa ĩrĩa ĩngĩ; ndũkanareke magatoonya ũhonokanio-inĩ waku.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

kikuyu: Ndeithũra na ũũhonokie nĩ ũndũ wa ũthingu waku; thikĩrĩria ũũhonokie.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

kikuyu: Moigaga atĩrĩ, “Ngai nĩamũtiganĩirie; hanyũkaniai nake mũmũnyiite, nĩgũkorwo ndarĩ mũndũ wa kũmũteithũra.”
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

kikuyu: Ndũrĩrĩ cia werũ-inĩ nĩikainamĩrĩra mbere yake, nacio thũ ciake icũne rũkũngũ.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ Ngai nĩ mwega harĩ andũ a Isiraeli, harĩ andũ arĩa atheru ngoro.
english: Surely God† is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩndaiguagĩra arĩa etĩĩi ũiru, rĩrĩa ndonire kũgaacĩra kwa andũ arĩa aaganu.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

kikuyu: Makoiga atĩrĩ, “Mũrungu angĩmenya atĩa? Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno nĩarĩ na ũmenyo?”
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa thĩ na andũ ayo othe maathingitha, nĩ niĩ nyiitagĩrĩra itugĩ ciayo ngacirũmia.
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa etĩĩi ngũmeera atĩrĩ, ‘Mũtigacooke kwĩraha,’ na arĩa aaganu ngameera atĩrĩ, ‘Mũtikambararie hĩa cianyu.
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

kikuyu: Wee nowe wa gwĩtigĩrwo. Nũũ ũngĩrũgama mbere yaku rĩrĩa ũrĩ mũrakaru?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, ndakũririkanire ngĩcaaya; ndataranirie maũndũ, naguo roho wakwa ũkĩringĩka.
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

kikuyu: Njĩra yaku yatuĩkanĩirie iria-inĩ, njĩra yaku ĩgĩtuĩkanĩria maaĩ-inĩ maingĩ, o na gũtuĩka makinya maku mationekire.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

kikuyu: Watongoririe andũ aku o ta ũrĩa mũrĩithi atongoragia rũũru, ũkĩmatongoria na guoko kwa Musa na kwa Harũni.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Ngũtumũra kanua gakwa njarie na ngerekano, ngũgweta maũndũ mahithe, maũndũ ma kuuma o tene:
english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

kikuyu: Nĩatũranirie mahiga kũu werũ-inĩ, na akĩmahe maaĩ maingĩ o ta ma iria;
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

kikuyu: Magĩũkĩrĩra Ngai na mĩario, makĩũrania atĩrĩ, “Mũrungu no ahote kwara metha werũ-inĩ?
english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

kikuyu: ngoro ciao itiarĩ njĩhokeku kũrĩ we, na matiarĩ eehokeku harĩ kĩrĩkanĩro gĩake.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

kikuyu: Andũ ake nao akĩmarekereria rũhiũ rwa njora; nĩarakarĩtio mũno nĩ igai rĩake.
english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

kikuyu: athĩnjĩri-Ngai ao makĩũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora, na atumia ao a ndigwa makĩaga kũmacakaĩra.
english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

kikuyu: no rĩrĩ, nĩathuurire mũhĩrĩga wa Juda, na Kĩrĩma gĩa Zayuni kĩrĩa endete.
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

kikuyu: Nĩaakire handũ harĩa hake haamũre hakĩhaana ta irĩma iria ndaaya, hakĩhaana ta thĩ ĩrĩa aahaandire ĩtũũre ĩrũmĩte nginya tene.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

kikuyu: Aathuurire Daudi ndungata yake na akĩmũruta ciugũ-inĩ cia ngʼondu;
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

kikuyu: Wee Ngai-rĩ, tũma tũgaacĩre rĩngĩ; tũma ũthiũ waku ũtwarĩre, nĩguo tũhonoke.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova Ngai mwene hinya wothe, marakara maku megũtooga nginya rĩ ũgĩũkĩrĩra mahooya ma andũ aku?
english: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

kikuyu: Wee Ngai-Mwene-Hinya-Wothe-rĩ, tũma tũgaacĩre rĩngĩ; tũma ũthiũ waku ũtwarĩre, nĩguo tũhonoke.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, tũcookerere! Rora ũrĩ igũrũ wone! Rũmbũiya mũthabibũ ũyũ,
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

kikuyu: Nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai waku, ũrĩa wakũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri. Athamia kanua gaku na nĩngũkũhe gĩa kũrĩa.
english: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai-rĩ, ndũgakire; tiga gũikara ũtumĩtie, Wee Mũrungu, ndũgaikare wĩnyiitanĩirie.
english: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

kikuyu: maingatithie o ro ũguo na kĩhuhũkanio gĩaku, na ũmamakie mũno na huho ciaku nene.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe-rĩ, kaĩ gĩikaro gĩaku nĩ gĩthaka-ĩ!
english: How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

kikuyu: Mathiiaga magĩkĩragĩrĩria kũgĩa na hinya, nginya o mũndũ o mũndũ agakinya mbere ya Ngai kũu Zayuni.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ Jehova no aheane kĩndũ o gĩothe kĩega, naguo bũrũri witũ ũciarage magetha maguo.
english: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, njigua na ũnjĩtĩke, nĩgũkorwo ndĩ mũthĩĩni na mũbatari.
english: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

kikuyu: He ndungata yaku gĩkeno, nĩgũkorwo nĩ kũrĩ we, Wee Mwathani, ndorereirie ngoro yakwa.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Igua ihooya rĩakwa, Wee Jehova; thikĩrĩria ikaya rĩakwa ũnjiguĩre tha.
english: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũrĩa ngaakorwo na thĩĩna nĩngagũkaĩra, nĩgũkorwo nĩũkanjĩtĩka.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

kikuyu: Ndũrĩrĩ ciothe iria ũmbĩte nĩigooka igũthathaiye irĩ mbere yaku, Wee Mwathani; nĩikarehera rĩĩtwa rĩaku riiri.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

kikuyu: Nĩũnjehereirie arata akwa arĩa twendanĩte mũno, na ũgatũma nduĩke kĩndũ kĩrĩ magigi harĩo. Ndĩĩmũhingĩrĩrie ndingĩhota kũũra;
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

kikuyu: Nĩũnjehereirie athiritũ akwa na arĩa nyendete; nduma nĩyo mũrata wakwa ũrĩa ũnguhĩrĩirie mũno.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

kikuyu: Ngũtũũra nyinaga ũhoro wa wendo mũnene wa Jehova nginya tene; ndĩrĩmenyithanagia wĩhokeku waku na kanua gakwa kũrĩ njiarwa na njiarwa.
english: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ thũ ĩkaamwĩtia igooti. gũtirĩ mũndũ mwaganu ũkaamũhinyĩrĩria.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

kikuyu: Nĩakanjĩta anjĩĩre atĩrĩ, ‘Wee nĩwe Baba, na Mũrungu wakwa, o Rwaro rwa Ihiga, Mũhonokia wakwa.’
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

kikuyu: mangĩgathũkia kĩrĩra kĩa watho wakwa wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo na mage kũmenyerera maathani makwa,
english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

kikuyu: Nĩũnyiihĩtie matukũ ma wĩthĩ wake; ũmũhumbĩte thoni o ta nguo.
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

kikuyu: Nĩ mũndũ ũrĩkũ ũngĩtũũra muoyo na ndonane na gĩkuũ, kana ehonokie kuuma kũrĩ hinya wa mbĩrĩra?
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?† Selah.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo mĩaka ngiri harĩwe no ta mũthenya wa ira ũrĩa ũrahĩtũkire, kana ta ituanĩra rĩmwe rĩa arangĩri a ũtukũ.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

kikuyu: Matukũ maitũ mothe maniinagwo nĩ mangʼũrĩ maku; tũninũkagia mĩaka iitũ na gũcaaya.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo gũtirĩ ũũru ũgaagũkorerera, gũtirĩ mwanangĩko ũgaakuhĩrĩria hema yaku.
english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

kikuyu: Nĩ wega mũno gũcookagĩria Jehova ngaatho o na gũkumagia rĩĩtwa rĩaku na rwĩmbo, Wee Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno,
english: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

kikuyu: We nĩarĩ hinya gũkĩra makũmbĩ ma iria, arĩ hinya gũkĩra marurumĩ macio ma maaĩ maingĩ, Jehova arĩ igũrũ nĩ arĩ hinya.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

kikuyu: Mahehenjaga andũ aku, Wee Jehova, makahinyĩrĩria igai rĩaku.
english: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.

kikuyu: Moigaga atĩrĩ, “Jehova ndangĩona; Ngai wa Jakubu-rĩ, ndangĩrũmbũiya.”
english: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

kikuyu: Ũrĩa wombire gũtũ-rĩ, ndangĩigua? Ũcio wombire riitho-rĩ, ndangĩona?
english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

kikuyu: Iria nĩ rĩake, nĩgũkorwo nĩwe warĩũmbire, na moko make nĩmo moombire thĩ nyũmũ.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

kikuyu: mũtikoomie ngoro cianyu ta ũrĩa mwekire mũrĩ Meriba, o na ta ũrĩa mwekire mũthenya ũrĩa mwarĩ Masa kũu werũ-inĩ,
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

kikuyu: Riiri na ũnene irĩ mbere yake; hinya na riiri irĩ handũ hake harĩa haamũre.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

kikuyu: Zayuni ĩiguaga ũguo ĩgakena, namo matũũra ma Juda magacanjamũka, tondũ wa matuĩro maku ma ciira, Wee Jehova.
english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo mahiga makuo nĩmakenagĩrwo nĩ ndungata ciaku; o na rũkũngũ rwakuo nĩrũtũmaga iringwo nĩ tha.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova nĩrĩkoimbũrwo kũu Zayuni, na nĩakagoocwo kũu Jerusalemu
english: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: rĩrĩa andũ a ndũrĩrĩ na mothamaki makoongana, mathathaiye Jehova.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

kikuyu: rĩhurutagwo nĩ rũhuho rĩkehera, na harĩa rĩraarĩ rĩtingĩcooka kuonwo rĩngĩ.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

kikuyu: Marikabu nĩkuo igeragĩra igĩthiĩ na igĩcooka, o na nyamũ ĩrĩa ĩĩtagwo Leviathani, ĩrĩa wombire nĩguo ĩtũũhagĩre kuo.
english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

kikuyu: Ithuĩ nĩtwĩhĩtie, o ta ũrĩa maithe maitũ meehirie; nĩtwĩkĩte ũũru na tũkaagana.
english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

kikuyu: Mwaki ũgĩakana gatagatĩ-inĩ ka arũmĩrĩri ao; rũrĩrĩmbĩ rũgĩcina andũ acio aaganu.
english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire gacaũ marĩ kũu Horebu, makĩhooya mũhianano ũtweketio kuuma kũrĩ kĩgera.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

kikuyu: nĩ ũndũ wao akĩririkana kĩrĩkanĩro gĩake, na nĩ ũndũ wa wendo wake mũnene akĩringwo nĩ tha.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Nĩmagĩcookerie Jehova ngaatho nĩ ũndũ wa wendo wake ũrĩa ũtathiraga, na mawĩko make ma magegania marĩa eekĩire andũ,
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: Magĩtuĩka a kũira ngoro mona irio o ciothe, nao magĩkuhĩrĩria ihingo cia gĩkuũ.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo magĩkaĩra Jehova marĩ mĩnyamaro-inĩ, nake akĩmaruta thĩĩna-inĩ.
english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Nĩmakĩrute igongona rĩa gũcookia ngaatho, na mamenyithanie mawĩko make makĩinaga nyĩmbo cia gĩkeno.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

kikuyu: Marikabu igĩikanio na igũrũ, na igĩcooka igĩikanio na kũu thĩ kũrĩa kũriku; andũ acio magĩkua ngoro nĩ ũndũ marĩ ũgwati-inĩ mũnene.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

kikuyu: nao andũ arĩa maarĩ ahũtu akĩmarehe kuo, nao magĩaka itũũra inene rĩa gũikara.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

kikuyu: Maarĩmire mĩgũnda na makĩhaanda mĩthabibũ, ĩrĩa yaciarire magetha maingĩ;
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

kikuyu: we ũrĩa ũnyararithagia andũ arĩa marĩ igweta-rĩ, agĩtũma morũũre kũndũ gũtaarĩ njĩra.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe mũũgĩ-rĩ, nĩarũmbũiye maũndũ macio, na ecũũranie ũhoro wa wendo mũnene wa Jehova.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩ nĩrĩtuĩke irĩhi rĩa Jehova kũrĩ arĩa maathitangaga, o kũrĩ arĩa maaragia ũũru igũrũ rĩakwa.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

kikuyu: Gwake mũciĩ gũkoragwo na ũtonga na indo nyingĩ, naguo ũthingu wake ũtũũraga nginya tene.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova. Mũgoocei, inyuĩ ndungata cia Jehova, mũgooce rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova.
english: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.

kikuyu: nĩĩrĩ matũ, no ndĩiguaga, nĩĩrĩ na maniũrũ, no ndĩiguaga mũnungo;
english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

kikuyu: nĩekũrathima arĩa metigĩrĩte Jehova, anini na anene o ũndũ ũmwe.
english: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ngĩkaĩra rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova, ngĩmwĩra atĩrĩ: “Wee Jehova, honokia!”
english: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa ndamakĩte, ngiuga atĩrĩ, “Andũ othe nĩ a maheeni.”
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

kikuyu: Nĩkuoya nguoya gĩkombe kĩa ũhonokio na igũrũ, ngaĩre rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, ti-itherũ niĩ ndĩ ndungata yaku; niĩ ndĩ ndungata yaku, mũriũ wa ndungata yaku ya mũndũ-wa-nja; wee nĩũnjohorithĩtie mĩnyororo-inĩ.
english: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

kikuyu: Jehova arĩ hamwe na niĩ; nĩwe mũndeithia. Nĩngerorera thũ ciakwa ikĩhootwo.
english: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩwe Mũrungu, na nĩatũmĩte ũtheri wake ũtwarĩre. Ambĩrĩriai gũkũngũiya, mũrĩ na mathĩgĩ moko, mũthiĩ nginya hĩa-inĩ cia kĩgongona.
english: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩra gĩaku nĩkĩo ngenagĩra; nĩkĩo kĩĩheaga mataaro.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

kikuyu: Nĩndakwĩrire mĩthiĩre yakwa nawe ũkĩnjĩtĩka; nduta kĩrĩra kĩa watho waku.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Erekeria ngoro yakwa kũrĩ kĩrĩra gĩaku, nĩguo ĩtige kwerekera ũhoro-inĩ wa gwĩtongia.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

kikuyu: Ndĩrĩthiiaga ndĩ na wĩyathi, nĩgũkorwo nĩmaathaga mawatho maku.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Ũũ nĩguo ngoretwo ngĩĩka: nĩnjathĩkagĩra mawatho maku.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

kikuyu: O na kũngĩtuĩka atĩ andũ arĩa aaganu no manjohe na mĩhĩndo-rĩ, ndingĩriganĩrwo nĩ watho waku.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Watho ũrĩa uumĩte kanua gaku nĩ wa bata mũno harĩ niĩ, gũkĩra ngiri cia icunjĩ cia betha na thahabu.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

kikuyu: Niĩ ndirĩ hĩndĩ ngaariganĩrwo nĩ mawatho maku, nĩgũkorwo ũndũũrĩtie muoyo nĩ ũndũ wamo.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa aaganu nĩmanyambĩire mũtego, no ndirĩ ndahĩtia kĩrĩra gĩaku.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

kikuyu: Mawatho maku nĩmo igai rĩakwa nginya tene; nĩmo gĩkeno kĩa ngoro yakwa.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

kikuyu: Ngoro yakwa nĩĩtuĩte kũrũmagia kĩrĩra kĩa watho waku o nginya mũthia.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

kikuyu: Menyerera ũgima wa ndungata yaku; ndũkareke andũ arĩa etĩĩi maahinyĩrĩrie.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

kikuyu: Maitho makwa manyũrũrũkagia maithori ta rũũĩ, nĩgũkorwo andũ matirathĩkĩra watho waku.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

kikuyu: Ngoretwo nĩ mathĩĩna na mĩnyamaro, no maathani maku nĩmo ngenagĩra.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

kikuyu: Ndĩragũkaĩra na ngoro yakwa yothe, Wee Jehova, njĩtĩka, na nĩndĩrĩathĩkagĩra kĩrĩra kĩa watho waku.
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

kikuyu: Igua mũgambo wakwa kũringana na wendo waku; Wee Jehova, tũũria muoyo wakwa, kũringana na mawatho maku.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa mathugundaga maũndũ ma wĩki naaĩ nĩmanguhĩrĩirie, no-o nĩmaraihanĩrĩirie na watho waku.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

kikuyu: No Wee Jehova, ũikaraga hakuhĩ, na maathani maku mothe nĩ ma ma.
english: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

kikuyu: Njathĩkagĩra mawatho maku na kĩrĩra gĩaku, nĩgũkorwo mĩthiĩre yakwa yothe nĩũmĩũĩ.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

kikuyu: Mathaithana makwa marokinya harĩwe; ndeithũra kũringana na kĩĩranĩro gĩaku.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

kikuyu: Kaĩ ndĩ na haaro-ĩ, nĩgũtũũra gũkũ Mesheki, na ngaikara hema-inĩ cia Kedari-ĩ!
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

kikuyu: Tũiguĩre tha, Wee Jehova, tũiguĩre tha, nĩgũkorwo nĩtũkirĩrĩirie kũnyararwo kũnene.
english: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

kikuyu: nĩmangĩatũmeririe tũrĩ muoyo; rĩrĩa marakara mao maatũrĩrĩmbũkĩire-rĩ,
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jehova aacookirie andũ a Zayuni arĩa maatahĩtwo akĩmainũkia-rĩ, twahaanire ta andũ mekũroota.
english: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

kikuyu: Kũrathimwo nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa thiaka wake ũiyũrĩte mĩguĩ. Matigaaconorithio rĩrĩa magaakorwo magĩciira na thũ ciao hau kĩhingo-inĩ.
english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

kikuyu: Mũtumia waku egũtuĩka ta mũthabibũ ũrĩa ũciaraga mũno arĩ kũu nyũmba-inĩ yaku thĩinĩ; ciana ciaku ituĩke ta thuuna cia mũtamaiyũ ithiũrũrũkĩirie metha yaku.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, igua mũgambo wakwa. Matũ maku nĩmaigue ngĩgũkaĩra ũnjiguĩre tha.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Nĩngahumba athĩnjĩri-Ngai akuo ũhonokio, na andũ akuo arĩa aamũre matũũre mainaga nĩ gũkena.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

kikuyu: Thũ ciake nĩngacihumba thoni, no thũmbĩ ya ũnene ĩrĩa ĩrĩ mũtwe wake nĩĩgakenga na riiri.”
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩethuurĩire Jakubu atuĩke wake, agathuura Isiraeli atuĩke igai rĩake kĩũmbe.
english: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

kikuyu: nĩwe watambũrũkirie thĩ nyũmũ igũrũ rĩa maaĩ, Wendo wake nĩ wa tene na tene.
english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: na guoko kwa hinya na atambũrũkĩtie gĩcoka gĩake, Wendo wake nĩ wa tene na tene.
english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: na akĩheana bũrũri wao ũtuĩke igai, Wendo wake nĩ wa tene na tene.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ngurumo-inĩ cia njũũĩ cia Babuloni nĩkuo twaikaraga thĩ tũkarĩra, twaririkana Zayuni.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

kikuyu: gũkena nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũhuragia tũkenge twaku, agatũgũthithia ndwaro-inĩ cia mahiga.†
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

kikuyu: Mahĩndĩ makwa matiahithĩkĩte harĩwe, rĩrĩa ndoombĩirwo kũrĩa kũhitharu. Rĩrĩa ndanyiitithanagio hamwe ndĩ thĩ kũrĩa kũriku mũno-rĩ,
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Gũthũũra ndĩmathũire o biũ; ndĩmatuaga thũ ciakwa.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, iga mũrangĩri kanua-inĩ gakwa, rangagĩra mũrango ũyũ wa mĩromo yakwa.
english: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

kikuyu: nyinĩre Ũrĩa ũhootanagĩra athamaki, o we ũhonokagia Daudi ndungata yake harĩ rũhiũ rwa njora rwa ũragani.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

kikuyu: Nĩmakaaria ũhoro wa ũkaru wa ũnene waku ũrĩa ũrĩ riiri, na niĩ ndaranagie ũhoro wa ciĩko ciaku cia magegania.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Jehova arĩ hakuhĩ na andũ arĩa othe mamũkayagĩra, arĩa othe mamũkayagĩra na ma.
english: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova. Kaĩ nĩ ũndũ mwega kũgooca Ngai witũ na rwĩmbo-ĩ, kaĩ nĩ ũndũ mwega na mwagĩrĩru kũmũgooca-ĩ!
english: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

kikuyu: Oiragia tharunji ĩhaana ta guoya mwerũ cua, nayo mbaa akamĩhurunja ta mũhu.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

kikuyu: Nĩaguũrĩtie kiugo gĩake harĩ Jakubu, akaguũrĩria Isiraeli mawatho make na kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo.
english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

kikuyu: Aaciigire handũ hacio itũũre ho tene na tene; aaheanire kĩrĩra kĩa watho wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo kĩrĩa gĩtagathira.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

kikuyu: nĩguo meerĩhĩrie harĩ ndũrĩrĩ, na maherithie kĩrĩndĩ gĩa thĩ,
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

kikuyu: nĩguo mamakinyĩrie ituĩro rĩrĩa mandĩkĩirwo. Ũcio nĩguo riiri wa andũ ake othe arĩa aamũre. Goocai Jehova.
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!

kikuyu: Mũgoocei nĩ ũndũ wa ciĩko ciake cia hinya; mũgoocei nĩ ũndũ wa ũnene wake mũingĩ mũno.
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

kikuyu: Niĩ, Johana, mũrũ wa ithe wanyu, na mũgwatanĩri na inyuĩ thĩinĩ wa mĩnyamaro, na ũthamaki, na gũkirĩrĩria tũũmĩrĩirie, o iria irĩ ciitũ thĩinĩ wa Jesũ, ndaarĩ gĩcigĩrĩra-inĩ kĩa iria kĩrĩa gĩĩtagwo Patimo tondũ wa Ũhoro wa Ngai na ũira wa Jesũ.
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Naguo mũtwe wake na njuĩrĩ yake ciarĩ njerũ cua ta guoya wa ngʼondu, cierũhĩte o ta ira, namo maitho make maahaanaga ta nĩnĩmbĩ cia mwaki.
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ndaamuonire ngĩgwa magũrũ-inĩ make ta mũndũ mũkuũ. Nake akĩnjigĩrĩra guoko gwake kwa ũrĩo, akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Tiga gwĩtigĩra. Nĩ niĩ wa Mbere, na ni niĩ wa Kũrigĩrĩria.
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

kikuyu: Nĩũkirĩrĩirie na ũkomĩrĩria mathĩĩna nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, na ndũrĩ wanoga.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have † not grown weary.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, kĩĩrire! Waga gwĩka ũguo, nĩngũũka kũrĩ we ica ikuhĩ, hũũrane nao na rũhiũ rũrũ rũrĩ kanua gakwa.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

kikuyu: “Kũrĩ mũraika wa kanitha wa Thuatira,§ mwandĩkĩre atĩrĩ: Ici nĩcio ciugo cia Mũrũ wa Ngai, ũrĩa ũrĩ na maitho matariĩ ta rũrĩrĩmbĩ rwa mwaki, na magũrũ make matariĩ ta gĩcango kĩrĩa gĩkumuthe gĩgathera.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

kikuyu: Nĩngooraga ciana ciake.† Namo makanitha mothe nĩmakamenya atĩ nĩ niĩ thuthuuragia ngoro na meciiria, na nĩngarĩha o mũndũ wanyu kũringana na ciĩko ciake.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

kikuyu: Arahũka! Ĩkĩra hinya maũndũ marĩa matigaire na marenda gũkua, nĩgũkorwo ndionete ciĩko ciaku irĩ nginyanĩru maitho-inĩ ma Ngai wakwa.
english: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away,† for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

kikuyu: “Kũrĩ mũraika wa kanitha wa Filadelifia,† mwandĩkĩre atĩrĩ: Ici nĩcio ciugo cia ũrĩa mũtheru na wa ma, ũrĩa ũnyiitĩte cabi ya Daudi. Kũrĩa ahingũra gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩhinga, na kũrĩa ahinga gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩhingũra.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

kikuyu: Thuutha wa maũndũ macio ngĩrora, na rĩrĩ, hau mbere yakwa haarĩ na mũrango warĩ mũhingũre kũu igũrũ. Naguo mũgambo ũrĩa ndaiguĩte mbere ĩyo ũkĩnjarĩria, ũrĩa wagambaga ta coro, ũkiuga atĩrĩ, “Ambata, ũũke haha, na nĩngũkuonia maũndũ marĩa arĩ o nginya mageekĩka thuutha wa maũndũ maya.”
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

kikuyu: Nakĩo gĩtĩ kĩu kĩa ũnene nĩkĩarigiicĩirio nĩ itĩ ingĩ cia ũnene mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na inya, nacio ciaikarĩirwo nĩ athuuri mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ana. Athuuri acio meehumbĩte nguo njerũ na magekĩra thũmbĩ cia thahabu mĩtwe.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

kikuyu: Na niĩ ngĩrora, ngĩona mbarathi njerũ* hau mbere yakwa! Ũrĩa wamĩhaicĩte aanyiitĩte ũta, nake akĩheo thũmbĩ, akiumĩra atariĩ ta mũtoorania werekeire o gũtoorania.
english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Gatũrũme aamethũrire gatembe ga keerĩ, ngĩigua kĩũmbe kĩrĩa kĩrĩ muoyo gĩa keerĩ kĩoiga atĩrĩ, “Ũka!”
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

kikuyu: nacio njata cia igũrũ ikĩgũa thĩ, o ta ũrĩa ngũyũ iria thaatu ciitĩkaga kuuma mũkũyũ-inĩ rĩrĩa wainainio nĩ rũhuho rũnene.*
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

kikuyu: Nao athamaki a thĩ, na anene, na anene a thigari, na itonga, na andũ arĩa marĩ hinya, na ngombo ciothe, na andũ arĩa othe eyathi, makĩĩhitha ngurunga-inĩ, na gatagatĩ ka ndwaro cia mahiga ma irĩma.
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

kikuyu: na a mũhĩrĩga wa Asheri maarĩ 12,000, na a mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali maarĩ 12,000, na a mũhĩrĩga wa Manase† maarĩ 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

kikuyu: Nao araika acio othe maarũgamĩte mathiũrũrũkĩirie gĩtĩ kĩu kĩa ũnene, na magathiũrũrũkĩria athuuri acio na ciũmbe icio inya irĩ muoyo. Nao magĩturumithia mothiũ mao thĩ hau mbere ya gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene, makĩhooya Ngai,
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

kikuyu: Ningĩ rĩrĩa Gatũrũme aamethũrire gatembe ka mũgwanja-rĩ, kũu igũrũ gũgĩkirwo ki ihinda ta rĩa nuthu ithaa.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

kikuyu: Mũraikawa mbere akĩhuhakarumbeta gake, nakuogũkĩgĩamburaya mbembe na mwaki itukanĩte na thakame, nacio igĩikio thĩ. Nakĩo gĩcunjĩ gĩa ithatũ gĩa thĩ gĩkĩhĩa, na gĩcunjĩ gĩa ithatũ kĩa mĩtĩ ĩkĩhĩa, o na nyeki yothe nduru ĩkĩhĩa.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up,† and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

kikuyu: Nacio ikĩaga kũheo ũhoti wa kũmooraga, o tiga wa kũmaherithia mĩeri ĩtano. Naruo ruo rũrĩa maiguire rwarĩ o ta ruo rwa kangʼaurũ karathĩte mũndũ.
english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

kikuyu: Nacio ciarĩ na ngo cia kũgitĩra gĩthũri ciahaanaga ta ngo cia kĩgera, naguo mũgambo wa mathagu maacio warĩ ta mũrurumo wa mbarathi nyingĩ na ngaari cia ita itengʼerete irorete mbaara-inĩ
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

kikuyu: Mũraika wa gatandatũ nake akĩhuha karumbeta gake, na niĩ ngĩigua mũgambo ũkiuma hĩa-inĩ cia kĩgongona gĩa thahabu kĩrĩa kĩrĩ mbere ya Ngai.†
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

kikuyu: Nake akĩĩhĩta na ũrĩa ũtũũraga muoyo nginya tene na tene, o we ũrĩa wombire igũrũ na indo ciothe iria irĩ kuo, na akĩũmba thĩ na indo ciothe iria irĩ kuo, o na akĩũmba iria na indo ciothe iria irĩ thĩinĩ warĩo, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Hatirĩ na ihinda rĩngĩ rĩa gweterera!”
english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

kikuyu: Ningĩ ngĩnengerwo mũrangi wa gũthima wahaanaga ta rũthanju, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ, “Thiĩ ũthime hekarũ ya Ngai na kĩgongona, na ũtare andũ arĩa marahooya Ngai kuo.
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ndamathia ĩyo ĩkĩrakarĩra mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio mũno, nayo ĩgĩthiĩ kũrũa na ciana iria ingĩ ciake, na nĩo andũ arĩa maathĩkagĩra maathani ma Ngai, na makagwatĩria ũira wa Jesũ.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring,† who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe angĩkorwo nĩ wa gũtahwo, nĩegũtahwo athiĩ. Mũndũ o wothe angĩkorwo nĩ wa kũũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora-rĩ, ndarĩ hĩndĩ atakooragwo na rũhiũ. Ũguo nĩkuonania atĩ andũ arĩa aamũre nĩmabataire gũkirĩrĩria, na marĩ na wĩtĩkio.
english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed.‡ Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

kikuyu: Tondũ wa morirũ macio nĩyaheirwo hinya wa kũringa ciama ithenya rĩa nyamũ ĩyo ya mbere, ĩkĩheenia andũ arĩa matũire thĩ. Ningĩ ĩgĩatha andũ mathondeke mũhianano nĩ ũndũ wa gũtĩĩa nyamũ ĩyo, yagurarĩtio na rũhiũ rwa njora no yarĩ o muoyo.
english: He deceives my own§ people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

kikuyu: nao maainaga rwĩmbo rwa Musa ũrĩa ndungata ya Ngai,* na rwĩmbo rwa Gatũrũme, makoiga atĩrĩ: “Maũndũ maku marĩa wĩkĩte nĩ manene na ma kũgegania, Wee Mwathani Ngai Mwene-Hinya-Wothe. Njĩra ciaku nĩ cia kĩhooto na nĩ cia ma, Wee Mũthamaki wa mĩndĩ na mĩndĩ.
english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo kĩũmbe kĩmwe gĩa ciũmbe iria inya irĩ muoyo-rĩ, gĩkĩnengera araika acio mũgwanja mbakũri mũgwanja cia thahabu, ciyũrĩtio mangʼũrĩ ma Ngai ũrĩa ũtũũraga muoyo tene na tene.
english: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

kikuyu: Mũraika wa gatano akĩonoreria mbakũri yake gĩtĩ-inĩ kĩa ũnene kĩa nyamũ ĩrĩa, naguo ũthamaki wayo ũkĩiyũra nduma. Nao andũ makĩĩrũma nĩmĩ nĩ ũndũ wa ruo,
english: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

kikuyu: Nake mũraika wa gatandatũ akĩonoreria mbakũri yake rũũĩ-inĩ rũrĩa rũnene rwa Farati, namo maaĩ maruo makĩhwa nĩguo athamaki a kuuma mwena wa Irathĩro mathondekerwo njĩra.
english: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.†

kikuyu: Nake mũraika ũmwe wa araika acio mũgwanja, maarĩ na mbakũri mũgwanja agĩũka, akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Ũka, nguonie iherithia rĩa mũmaraya ũrĩa mũnene, ũrĩa ũikarĩte igũrũ rĩa maaĩ maingĩ.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

kikuyu: Nyamũ ĩrĩa yarĩ kuo, na rĩu ndĩrĩ ho, nĩyo mũthamaki wa kanana. We nĩ ũmwe wa acio mũgwanja, na rĩu erekeire kwanangwo.
english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

kikuyu: Marĩ na muoroto ũmwe, na nĩmakaheana ũhoti na wathani wao kũrĩ nyamũ ĩyo.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Ngai nĩekĩrĩte ngoro-inĩ ciao rĩciiria rĩa kũhingia muoroto wake na ũndũ wa kũiguanĩra mahe nyamũ ĩyo hinya wao wa gwathana, nginya ciugo cia Ngai ihinge.
english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa maũndũ macio nĩndonire mũraika ũngĩ agĩikũrũka oimĩte igũrũ arĩ na ũhoti mũnene mũno, nayo thĩ ĩkĩarĩrwo nĩ ũkengi wake.
english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

kikuyu: Nake akĩanĩrĩra na mũgambo mũnene, akiuga atĩrĩ: “Nĩrĩgũu! Babuloni itũũra rĩrĩa inene-rĩ, nĩrĩgwĩte! Nĩrĩtuĩkĩte gĩikaro kĩa ndaimono, na rĩgatuĩka gĩtũũro gĩa gũthaakĩrwo nĩ ngoma o yothe thũku, rĩgatuĩka gĩtũũro kĩa nyoni ciothe iria irĩ thaahu na thũũre.
english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo matuĩro make ma ciira nĩ ma ma, na nĩ ma kĩhooto. Tondũ nĩatuĩrĩire mũmaraya ũcio mũnene ciira, ũcio wathũkirie thĩ na ũtharia wake. Na nĩamũrĩhĩtie thakame ya ndungata ciake.”
english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

kikuyu: Nake mũhiki ũcio akĩheo nguo cia taama ya gatani ĩrĩa njega, ĩ gũkenga na theru, nĩguo ehumbe.” (Taama wa gatani ĩrĩa njega nĩguo ciĩko cia ũthingu cia andũ arĩa aamũre.)
english: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

kikuyu: Ningĩ kanua-inĩ gake koimĩte rũhiũ rwa njora rũũgĩ rwa kũũraga ndũrĩrĩ naruo. Nake agaaciathaga na rũthanju rwa kĩgera na arangĩrĩrie ihihĩro rĩa ndibei rĩa mangʼũrĩ marũrũ ma Ngai Mwene-Hinya-Wothe.
english: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod.* He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

kikuyu: Nake mũcukani, ũrĩa wamaheenirie, agĩikio iria rĩa mwaki wa ũbiriti, o kũrĩa nyamũ ĩrĩa na mũnabii ũrĩa wa maheeni maikĩtio. Nao magaatũũra manyariiragwo mũthenya na ũtukũ tene na tene.
english: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũndũ o wothe akorwo rĩĩtwa rĩake rĩtionekire rĩandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa muoyo-rĩ, agĩikio iria-inĩ rĩu rĩa mwaki.
english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

kikuyu: Naruo rũthingo rwa itũũra rĩu inene rwarĩ na mĩthingi ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ, na igũrũ rĩayo ĩkaandĩkwo marĩĩtwa ma atũmwo arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ a Gatũrũme.
english: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

kikuyu: Rũthingo rũu rwakĩtwo na njathibi, narĩo itũũra rĩu inene rĩakĩĩtwo na thahabu ĩrĩa therie, ĩgathera o ta gĩcicio.
english: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

kikuyu: Nacio ndũrĩrĩ igaathiiaga na ũtheri warĩo, nao athamaki a thĩ marehe riiri wao thĩinĩ warĩo.
english: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

kikuyu: rũikũrũkĩire gatagatĩ ka njĩra ĩrĩa nene ya itũũra inene. Mĩena yeerĩ ya rũũĩ rũu, o mwena warĩ na mũtĩ wa muoyo, naguo waciaraga matunda mĩthemba ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ, ũgaciaraga maciaro maguo o mweri. Namo mathangũ ma mũtĩ ũcio maarĩ ma kũhonia andũ a ndũrĩrĩ.
english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

kikuyu: Na mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ angĩkeeheria ciugo thĩinĩ wa ibuku rĩĩrĩ rĩa ũrathi, Ngai nĩakamwehereria igai rĩake kuuma mũtĩ-inĩ wa muoyo, o na kuuma itũũra-inĩ rĩu itheru, iria itaarĩirio thĩinĩ wa ibuku rĩĩrĩ.
english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree§ of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

kikuyu: Ndĩramwandĩkĩra marũa maya inyuothe arĩa mũrĩ kũu Roma, o inyuĩ mwendetwo nĩ Ngai, na mũgetwo mũtuĩke andũ aamũre: Wega na thayũ kuuma kũrĩ Ngai Ithe witũ, na kuuma kũrĩ Mwathani Jesũ Kristũ, iroikara na inyuĩ.
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: mahooya-inĩ makwa hĩndĩ ciothe; na nĩndĩrahooya atĩ rĩu nĩ ũndũ wa kwenda kwa Ngai no hingũrĩrwo njĩra nĩguo njũke kũrĩ inyuĩ.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

kikuyu: Ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ndikwenda mwage kũmenya atĩ nĩ mahinda maingĩ ndanabanga kũmũceerera (no ndanagirĩrĩrio gwĩka ũguo nginya rĩu) nĩgeetha ngĩe na maciaro thĩinĩ wanyu, o ta ũrĩa ngĩĩte na maciaro thĩinĩ wa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ iria ingĩ.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: nao magĩkũũrania riiri wa Ngai ũrĩa mũtũũra muoyo na mĩhianano ĩthondeketwo ĩkahaana ta andũ arĩa makuuaga, na nyoni, na nyamũ cia magũrũ mana, o na nyamũ iria itaambaga thĩ.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

kikuyu: hakĩrĩ ũguo-rĩ, wee ũrutaga andũ arĩa angĩ- rĩ, ndũngĩkĩĩruta wee mwene? Wee ũhunjagia atĩ andũ matikaiye-rĩ, wee nĩũiyaga?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ, “Rĩĩtwa rĩa Ngai nĩrĩcambagio thĩinĩ wa andũ- a-Ndũrĩrĩ nĩ ũndũ wanyu.”
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,”* just as it is written.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo arĩa matarĩ aruu nĩmahingagia maũndũ marĩa mabataranagia thĩinĩ wa watho-rĩ, githĩ acio matiagĩrĩire gũtuuo ta maruĩte?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

kikuyu: Ngai aamũrutire arĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroheria mehia na ũndũ wa wĩtĩkio thĩinĩ wa thakame yake. Ngai eekire ũguo nĩgeetha onanie ũthingu wake, tondũ wa ũrĩa mehia ma mbere ĩyo maarekeirwo andũ matekũherithio, nĩ ũndũ wa gũkirĩrĩria kwa Ngai,
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice† through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

kikuyu: Ngai-rĩ, akĩrĩ o Ngai wa Ayahudi oiki? Githĩ Ngai ti wa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ o nao? Ĩĩ, nĩ Ngai wa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ o nao,
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Maandĩko marĩa matheru moigĩte atĩa? “Iburahĩmu nĩetĩkirie Ngai, naguo ũndũ ũcio ũgĩtũma atuuo mũthingu.”
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”*

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mũndũ aruta wĩra-rĩ, mũcaara wake ũrĩa aheagwo ndũkoragwo ũrĩ ta kĩheo, no nĩ ta thiirĩ ararĩhwo.
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
